disciplines.name: Arms
disciplines.theme: Distance, timing and the practiced turn of a weapon.

disciplines.name: Armor
disciplines.theme: Wear your protection as though it were part of you.

disciplines.name: Guard
disciplines.theme: Be where someone needs you before they have to ask.

disciplines.name: Marksmanship
disciplines.theme: Find the line between your hand and a distant mark.

disciplines.name: Athletics
disciplines.theme: Find a way where the easy road ends.

disciplines.name: Subterfuge
disciplines.theme: Work between what people notice and what they assume.

disciplines.name: Wilderness
disciplines.theme: Read a living landscape and find your place within it.

disciplines.name: Medicine
disciplines.theme: Recognize hurt, and work patiently to ease it.

disciplines.name: Craft
disciplines.theme: See the useful thing waiting inside the material.

disciplines.name: Scholarship
disciplines.theme: Ask the question that turns an old fact into a useful one.

disciplines.name: Influence
disciplines.theme: Open a door, steady a friend or turn a room.

disciplines.name: Elements
disciplines.theme: Shape the physical world: heat, water, stone and air.

disciplines.name: Life
disciplines.theme: Restore, transform, cultivate and unravel living things.

disciplines.name: Mentalism
disciplines.theme: Thought, feeling, perception and the dreaming mind.

disciplines.name: Divination
disciplines.theme: Find what is hidden across distance, history and possibility.

disciplines.name: Invocation
disciplines.theme: Contact beings, establish bonds and cross boundaries.

disciplines.name: Force
disciplines.theme: Move, shape, animate and enchant the material world.

disciplines.name: Wards
disciplines.theme: Protect people and places; secure and unravel magic.

disciplines.name: Spellcraft
disciplines.theme: Study your reserves, restore your focus, and channel magical power.

nodes.name: Arms
nodes.effect: Distance, timing and the practiced turn of a weapon.

nodes.name: Measured Cut I
nodes.effect: Main Action · Brawn. Attack one adjacent creature for 2/3/5 physical damage. On Strong, you may move 1 square after the attack.

nodes.name: Measured Cut II
nodes.effect: Measured Cut deals +1 damage on every result: 3/4/6 physical damage.

nodes.name: Measured Cut III
nodes.effect: Measured Cut also applies Bleeding 1 on Strong.

nodes.name: Sweeping Blade
nodes.effect: Main Action · Brawn. Attack up to three adjacent enemies. Roll once; each takes 1/2/4 physical damage. Measured Cut improvements do not apply.

nodes.name: Driving Blow I
nodes.effect: Main Action · Brawn. Attack one adjacent creature for 2/3/5 physical damage. On Strong, push it 1 square directly away from you.

nodes.name: Driving Blow II
nodes.effect: Driving Blow pushes 2 squares instead of 1 on Strong.

nodes.name: Driving Blow III
nodes.effect: Driving Blow also applies Dazed 1 on Strong, whether or not the target can be pushed.

nodes.name: Battering Stroke
nodes.effect: Main Action · Brawn. Deal 2/3/5 physical damage to one adjacent creature. Push it up to 2 squares directly away from you. Resolve collisions normally.

nodes.name: Hamstring I
nodes.effect: Main Action · Brawn. Attack one adjacent creature for 2/3/5 physical damage. On Strong, apply Slowed 1.

nodes.name: Hamstring II
nodes.effect: Hamstring applies Slowed 2 instead of Slowed 1 on Strong.

nodes.name: Hamstring III
nodes.effect: Hamstring deals +1 damage on every result: 3/4/6 physical damage.

nodes.name: Pinning Strike
nodes.effect: Main Action · Brawn. Attack one adjacent creature for 2/3/5 physical damage. On Strong, its movement is 0 until the end of its next turn. Forced movement still affects it. Before rolling against a living creature with positive HP, you may declare a nonlethal strike. Resolve damage normally. If this hit would reduce it to 0 HP, leave it at 1 HP and make it Unconscious for 1 minute or until it next takes damage. The creature falls prone and can be restrained while unconscious.

nodes.name: Blade Ward I
nodes.effect: Reaction · After resolving your melee defense roll, before taking damage: reduce that attack’s damage by 2, minimum 1. No additional roll.

nodes.name: Blade Ward II
nodes.effect: Blade Ward reduces damage by 3 instead of 2.

nodes.name: Blade Ward III
nodes.effect: After Blade Ward resolves, you may move 1 square. This movement does not trigger reactions.

nodes.name: Riposte
nodes.effect: Reaction · After resolving a melee attack against you, attack its source if adjacent. Roll Brawn for 2/3/5 physical damage. You must still have your reaction available.

nodes.name: Armor
nodes.effect: Wear your protection as though it were part of you.

nodes.name: Armored Training I
nodes.effect: Passive. While wearing light armor, gain physical resistance 1.

nodes.name: Armored Training II
nodes.effect: Armored Training also permits medium armor, granting physical resistance 2 while worn.

nodes.name: Armored Training III
nodes.effect: Armored Training also permits heavy armor, granting physical resistance 3 while worn.

nodes.name: Ironbound Advance
nodes.effect: Maneuver. Move up to 3 squares through nonmagical difficult terrain, ignoring its extra movement cost. Until your turn ends, gain Stability 2.

nodes.name: Brace I
nodes.effect: Reaction. When an effect would push or pull you, shorten that movement by 1 square, minimum 0. No roll; damage still applies.

nodes.name: Brace II
nodes.effect: Brace shortens forced movement by 2 squares instead of 1.

nodes.name: Brace III
nodes.effect: Brace also prevents that same effect from knocking you Prone.

nodes.name: Stand Like Stone
nodes.effect: Maneuver. Until your next turn starts, gain Stability 3 and cannot be moved against your will. You cannot move voluntarily while this lasts.

nodes.name: Turn the Blow I
nodes.effect: Reaction. After your defense roll, before taking physical damage, reduce that attack’s damage by 1, minimum 1. No additional roll.

nodes.name: Turn the Blow II
nodes.effect: Turn the Blow reduces physical damage by 2 instead of 1.

nodes.name: Turn the Blow III
nodes.effect: Turn the Blow reduces physical damage by 3 instead of 2.

nodes.name: Weather the Storm
nodes.effect: Main Action. Until your next turn starts, reduce damage from each attack against you by 2 after resistance, minimum 1 per attack.

nodes.name: Armored March I
nodes.effect: Passive. Ignore 1 Bulk from your worn armor when calculating encumbrance; minimum 0 armor Bulk. This does not change the armor’s inventory size.

nodes.name: Armored March II
nodes.effect: Armored March also increases your Speed by 1 while wearing armor.

nodes.name: Armored March III
nodes.effect: Armored March also ignores the extra movement cost of the first square of nonmagical difficult terrain you enter on each turn.

nodes.name: Carry Them Home
nodes.effect: Maneuver. Lift one willing or helpless adjacent creature no larger than you. For this turn, carrying it adds no encumbrance and does not occupy your weapon hand. Put it down adjacent when your turn ends.

nodes.name: Guard
nodes.effect: Be where someone needs you before they have to ask.

nodes.name: Interpose I
nodes.effect: Reaction. After an adjacent ally rolls defense, reduce the physical damage of that attack by 1, minimum 1. You must be able to reach the ally.

nodes.name: Interpose II
nodes.effect: Interpose reduces physical damage by 2 instead of 1.

nodes.name: Interpose III
nodes.effect: Before Interpose, you may move 1 square to reach the ally. This movement does not trigger reactions.

nodes.name: Take the Blow
nodes.effect: Reaction. Before an adjacent ally rolls defense against a single-target attack, become its target. You roll your own defense and receive all effects; the ally receives none.

nodes.name: Shield Bash I
nodes.effect: Main Action · Brawn. Attack one adjacent creature for 1/2/3 physical damage. On Strong, push it 1 square directly away.

nodes.name: Shield Bash II
nodes.effect: Shield Bash deals 2/3/4 physical damage instead of 1/2/3.

nodes.name: Shield Bash III
nodes.effect: Shield Bash also knocks the target Prone on Strong after the push.

nodes.name: Break the Line
nodes.effect: Main Action · Brawn. Attack up to two adjacent creatures. Roll once; each takes 1/2/3 physical damage and is pushed 1 square directly away.

nodes.name: Sheltering Guard I
nodes.effect: Maneuver. Choose one adjacent ally. Until your next turn starts, it gains 1 Boon on ranged defense rolls while adjacent to you. Reusing this ability replaces its previous effect.

nodes.name: Sheltering Guard II
nodes.effect: Sheltering Guard can protect two adjacent allies instead of one.

nodes.name: Sheltering Guard III
nodes.effect: Sheltering Guard also gives its protected allies Stability 1 while adjacent to you.

nodes.name: Shield Canopy
nodes.effect: Main Action. Until your next turn starts, you and up to three adjacent allies reduce damage from ranged attacks by 2, minimum 1. An ally loses this benefit when no longer adjacent.

nodes.name: Guarded Passage I
nodes.effect: Reaction. When an adjacent ally triggers a movement reaction, impose 1 Boon on its defense against that reaction. Declare before the defense roll.

nodes.name: Guarded Passage II
nodes.effect: Guarded Passage gives 2 Boons instead of 1 to that defense.

nodes.name: Guarded Passage III
nodes.effect: Guarded Passage also reduces damage from that reaction by 1, minimum 1.

nodes.name: Rescue Step
nodes.effect: Maneuver. Move up to 2 squares to an ally, then move with that willing ally up to 2 more squares. Both movements ignore movement reactions. Finish adjacent; both must have a legal route.

nodes.name: Marksmanship
nodes.effect: Find the line between your hand and a distant mark.

nodes.name: Measured Shot I
nodes.effect: Main Action · Agility. Attack one creature within 8 squares for 2/3/5 physical damage.

nodes.name: Measured Shot II
nodes.effect: Measured Shot deals +1 damage on every result: 3/4/6.

nodes.name: Measured Shot III
nodes.effect: Measured Shot has range 12 squares instead of 8.

nodes.name: Split the Flight
nodes.effect: Main Action · Agility. Attack up to three creatures within 8 squares. Roll once; each takes 1/2/4 physical damage. Spend one projectile per target. Measured Shot improvements do not apply.

nodes.name: Hobbling Shot I
nodes.effect: Main Action · Agility. Attack one creature within 8 squares for 1/2/4 physical damage. On Strong, apply Slowed 1.

nodes.name: Hobbling Shot II
nodes.effect: Hobbling Shot applies Slowed 2 instead of 1 on Strong.

nodes.name: Hobbling Shot III
nodes.effect: Hobbling Shot also applies Slowed 1 on Standard; Strong still applies Slowed 2.

nodes.name: Hold the Pass
nodes.effect: Main Action · Agility. Attack up to two creatures within 8 squares. Roll once; each takes 1/2/3 physical damage and Slowed 1. Spend one projectile per target.

nodes.name: Watchful Shot I
nodes.effect: Reaction. When a visible enemy within 6 squares finishes voluntary movement, attack it with Agility for 1/2/3 physical damage. Resolve after it moves; you need a ready weapon.

nodes.name: Watchful Shot II
nodes.effect: Watchful Shot has range 8 squares instead of 6.

nodes.name: Watchful Shot III
nodes.effect: Watchful Shot deals 1/2/4 physical damage instead of 1/2/3.

nodes.name: Covering Fire
nodes.effect: Main Action · Agility. Attack one enemy within 8 squares for 1/2/4 physical damage. One ally within 4 squares of you may immediately move 2 squares without triggering reactions from that enemy.

nodes.name: Hurl I
nodes.effect: Main Action · Agility. Throw one held weapon at a creature within 4 squares for 2/3/5 physical damage.

nodes.name: Hurl II
nodes.effect: Hurl has range 6 squares instead of 4.

nodes.name: Hurl III
nodes.effect: After Hurl, draw one accessible replacement weapon without spending an action. This does not retrieve the thrown weapon.

nodes.name: Ricochet
nodes.effect: Main Action · Agility. Throw one weapon at two creatures within 4 squares of you and 2 squares of each other. Roll once; each takes 1/2/4 physical damage. The weapon lands beside the second target.

nodes.name: Athletics
nodes.effect: Find a way where the easy road ends.

nodes.name: Sure Ascent I
nodes.effect: Passive. Gain 1 Boon on Brawn or Agility rolls to climb a surface with usable holds. You still need a feasible route.

nodes.name: Sure Ascent II
nodes.effect: Sure Ascent lets you climb 1 square per movement spent instead of paying extra for climbing; rolls for danger still apply.

nodes.name: Sure Ascent III
nodes.effect: Sure Ascent also lets you keep one hand free while stationary on a climb with usable holds.

nodes.name: A Line for Everyone
nodes.effect: Main Action. With rope and a secure anchor within reach, rig a line up to 10 squares long. Up to six creatures may climb it at normal movement cost while it remains secured. It cannot bridge unsupported open space.

nodes.name: Running Vault I
nodes.effect: Maneuver. After moving at least 2 squares this turn, jump up to 2 squares horizontally to a visible landing. Spend no additional movement. You cannot finish in occupied space.

nodes.name: Running Vault II
nodes.effect: Running Vault reaches up to 3 squares instead of 2.

nodes.name: Running Vault III
nodes.effect: Running Vault also ignores movement reactions during the jump.

nodes.name: Follow My Leap
nodes.effect: Maneuver. Use Running Vault and guide one willing adjacent ally through the same jump immediately after you. The ally lands adjacent to your destination; both landing squares must be legal.

nodes.name: Strong Swimmer I
nodes.effect: Passive. Gain 1 Boon on Brawn rolls to swim through rough water. You still need breathable air and cannot swim through an impossible current.

nodes.name: Strong Swimmer II
nodes.effect: Strong Swimmer removes extra movement cost for swimming in calm water.

nodes.name: Strong Swimmer III
nodes.effect: Strong Swimmer lets you tow one willing or helpless creature no larger than you without additional swimming movement cost.

nodes.name: Carry Them to Shore
nodes.effect: Main Action · Brawn. Swim up to 2/3/4 squares, towing one willing or helpless adjacent creature no larger than you. The current must permit passage. The passenger moves with you.

nodes.name: Catch Your Balance I
nodes.effect: Reaction. When you would fall Prone, remain standing instead. You must be conscious and able to move; no roll.

nodes.name: Catch Your Balance II
nodes.effect: Catch Your Balance can also catch a ledge within your reach when you begin to fall, leaving you hanging instead of falling.

nodes.name: Catch Your Balance III
nodes.effect: After Catch Your Balance, you may move 1 square to a safe unoccupied surface within reach without triggering reactions.

nodes.name: Catch Them Falling
nodes.effect: Reaction. Catch one adjacent falling creature no larger than you. If you have secure footing and a free hand, bring it to a free adjacent square. Otherwise you both hang from a reachable secure hold. No hold means you cannot use this ability.

nodes.name: Subterfuge
nodes.effect: Work between what people notice and what they assume.

nodes.name: Quiet Passage I
nodes.effect: Passive. Gain 1 Boon on Agility rolls to move quietly while concealed. You cannot hide in plain sight without a distraction or cover.

nodes.name: Quiet Passage II
nodes.effect: Quiet Passage removes extra movement cost imposed solely by sneaking.

nodes.name: Quiet Passage III
nodes.effect: Quiet Passage extends its Boon to one willing adjacent companion moving with you and using the same concealment.

nodes.name: Vanish into Cover
nodes.effect: Maneuver · Agility. Move up to 2 squares into cover, then add 1/2/3 progress toward evading pursuers. The DA sets the objective; become Hidden when it is completed and concealment remains plausible.

nodes.name: Patient Hand I
nodes.effect: 10 minutes · Guile, with lock tools. Work on one reachable nonmagical lock or mechanism; add 1/2/3 progress toward the DA’s opening objective. Basic tools cannot defeat an impossible mechanism.

nodes.name: Patient Hand II
nodes.effect: Patient Hand adds 1/3/4 progress instead of 1/2/3.

nodes.name: Patient Hand III
nodes.effect: Patient Hand takes 5 minutes per attempt instead of 10.

nodes.name: Open under Pressure
nodes.effect: Main Action · Guile, with lock tools. Work on a nonmagical lock already examined with Patient Hand; add 1/2/3 progress. Until this lock opens, you may repeat this faster action.

nodes.name: Light Fingers I
nodes.effect: Main Action · Guile. With a free hand, palm or plant one unattended palm-sized object within reach; add 1/2/3 progress toward doing so unnoticed. The DA sets the objective and decides whether scrutiny allows the attempt.

nodes.name: Light Fingers II
nodes.effect: Light Fingers adds 1/3/4 progress instead of 1/2/3.

nodes.name: Light Fingers III
nodes.effect: Light Fingers can also target an accessible object worn or carried by a distracted creature; not a held weapon, secured container or worn armor.

nodes.name: Switch the Prize
nodes.effect: Main Action · Guile. Using Light Fingers, exchange a reachable palm-sized object with a similar object you carry as one task. Use its improved progress; the exchange occurs when the objective is completed.

nodes.name: Read the Snare I
nodes.effect: 1 minute · Reason. Inspect a reachable suspected trap without touching its trigger; add 1/2/3 progress to identify the trigger and danger. Inspection cannot reveal inaccessible components.

nodes.name: Read the Snare II
nodes.effect: Read the Snare adds 1/3/4 progress instead of 1/2/3.

nodes.name: Read the Snare III
nodes.effect: After Read the Snare identifies a trap, gain 1 Boon on your Guile rolls to disarm that trap with suitable tools.

nodes.name: Turn the Trap
nodes.effect: 10 minutes · Guile, with tools. Reconfigure an identified nonmagical trap; add 1/2/3 progress to the DA’s objective. On completion, choose a reachable trigger position or safe bypass. Its damage and scale do not increase.

nodes.name: Wilderness
nodes.effect: Read a living landscape and find your place within it.

nodes.name: Read the Trail I
nodes.effect: 10 minutes · Reason. Examine physical tracks; add 1/2/3 progress toward following a trail to the DA’s next landmark. Each completed objective reveals direction, approximate numbers and freshness.

nodes.name: Read the Trail II
nodes.effect: Read the Trail adds 1/3/4 progress instead of 1/2/3.

nodes.name: Read the Trail III
nodes.effect: Read the Trail takes 5 minutes per attempt instead of 10.

nodes.name: Cut Them Off
nodes.effect: 10 minutes · Reason. From a trail you have followed, identify a feasible interception route; add 1/2/3 progress toward the DA’s objective. Completion reveals the route and travel time; it does not guarantee you arrive first.

nodes.name: Wild Harvest I
nodes.effect: 1 hour · Knowledge. Search a fresh area with edible resources. Gather 1/2/3 person-days of food, or that many person-days of drinkable water if a water source exists. The DA defines the area before rolling; it yields once per day to the whole party.

nodes.name: Wild Harvest II
nodes.effect: Wild Harvest yields 2/3/4 person-days instead of 1/2/3.

nodes.name: Wild Harvest III
nodes.effect: Wild Harvest gathers both food and water in the same hour when both resources exist; each uses the rolled yield.

nodes.name: Find the Hidden Spring
nodes.effect: 1 hour · Reason. Search terrain that could hold water; add 1/2/3 progress toward locating a concealed source. Completion reveals its location and visible hazards. It creates no water and does not purify a polluted source.

nodes.name: Trail Shelter I
nodes.effect: 1 hour, with available shelter materials. Prepare a dry campsite for up to two people against ordinary rain and wind. No roll. It does not make a dangerous location safe or accelerate overnight recovery.

nodes.name: Trail Shelter II
nodes.effect: Trail Shelter accommodates four people instead of two.

nodes.name: Trail Shelter III
nodes.effect: Trail Shelter takes 30 minutes instead of 1 hour.

nodes.name: A Camp without a Trace
nodes.effect: 30 minutes · Guile. Conceal a completed camp and its approach; add 1/2/3 progress toward the DA’s concealment objective. Completion hides casual signs; direct search can still discover the camp.

nodes.name: Gentle Hand I
nodes.effect: 1 minute · Reason. Calm one nonmagical animal within 2 squares that can perceive you; add 1/2/3 progress toward ending its immediate fear or agitation. Provide a credible calming approach; immediate danger can prevent progress.

nodes.name: Gentle Hand II
nodes.effect: Gentle Hand adds 1/3/4 progress instead of 1/2/3.

nodes.name: Gentle Hand III
nodes.effect: Gentle Hand can address up to three animals sharing the same cause of agitation as one objective.

nodes.name: Lead the Herd
nodes.effect: 10 minutes · Reason. Guide up to six calm nonmagical animals along a safe route; add 1/2/3 progress toward the DA’s handling objective. Completion gets them moving with you; danger or mistreatment ends cooperation.

nodes.name: Medicine
nodes.effect: Recognize hurt, and work patiently to ease it.

nodes.name: Field Dressing I
nodes.effect: 10 minutes · Knowledge, using medical supplies. Treat one creature within reach; restore 3/5/7 HP. This replaces ordinary first aid and consumes the recipient’s first-aid attempt.

nodes.name: Field Dressing II
nodes.effect: Field Dressing restores 4/6/8 HP instead of 3/5/7.

nodes.name: Field Dressing III
nodes.effect: Field Dressing takes 5 minutes instead of 10.

nodes.name: Emergency Treatment
nodes.effect: Main Action · Knowledge, using medical supplies. Apply Field Dressing’s current healing immediately to one adjacent creature. Mark the recipient’s first-aid attempt as used.

nodes.name: Staunch I
nodes.effect: Main Action. With a free hand and suitable bandaging, reduce an adjacent creature’s Bleeding by 2, minimum 0. This restores no HP and consumes no first-aid allowance.

nodes.name: Staunch II
nodes.effect: Staunch reduces Bleeding by 3 instead of 2.

nodes.name: Staunch III
nodes.effect: Staunch takes a Maneuver instead of a Main Action.

nodes.name: Keep Them Breathing
nodes.effect: Reaction. When an adjacent creature takes damage at 0 HP, grant 1 Boon to its immediate death roll. Declare before the roll. Apply that roll’s result to its death roll tallies.

nodes.name: Read the Symptoms I
nodes.effect: 10 minutes · Knowledge. Examine a willing or helpless creature; add 1/2/3 progress toward identifying a nonmagical disease or toxin and a plausible remedy. You need observable symptoms or a sample.

nodes.name: Read the Symptoms II
nodes.effect: Read the Symptoms adds 1/3/4 progress instead of 1/2/3.

nodes.name: Read the Symptoms III
nodes.effect: Read the Symptoms takes 5 minutes per attempt instead of 10.

nodes.name: Prepare the Remedy
nodes.effect: 1 hour · Knowledge, with ingredients appropriate to a diagnosed toxin. Prepare one dose; add 1/2/3 progress toward the DA’s preparation objective. Administer as a Main Action: reduce that toxin’s Poisoned by 2. Other disease effects need their stated remedy.

nodes.name: Patient Care I
nodes.effect: Main Action. Warm or cool one adjacent willing creature with suitable water, blankets or other supplies; reduce temporary Freezing or Burning by 2. No roll, HP restoration or first-aid expenditure.

nodes.name: Patient Care II
nodes.effect: Patient Care reduces the chosen condition by 3 instead of 2.

nodes.name: Patient Care III
nodes.effect: Patient Care can treat two adjacent willing creatures with the same Main Action, with enough supplies for both.

nodes.name: Watch through the Night
nodes.effect: During a safe overnight rest, tend up to four willing patients during your two quiet hours. Each gains 1 Boon on its next Fortitude roll against an existing nonmagical disease before its next overnight rest. Normal sleep and recovery requirements remain.

nodes.name: Craft
nodes.effect: See the useful thing waiting inside the material.

nodes.name: Mend and Fit I
nodes.effect: 10 minutes · Knowledge, with tools and matching materials. Repair one nonmagical item; add 1/2/3 progress toward the DA’s repair objective. The item must retain enough structure to repair.

nodes.name: Mend and Fit II
nodes.effect: Mend and Fit adds 1/3/4 progress instead of 1/2/3.

nodes.name: Mend and Fit III
nodes.effect: Mend and Fit takes 5 minutes per attempt instead of 10.

nodes.name: Field Repair
nodes.effect: Main Action · Knowledge, with tools and materials. Work on an item already examined with Mend and Fit; add 1/2/3 repair progress. Until it is repaired, you may repeat this faster action. The completed repair restores the item’s ordinary function.

nodes.name: Trail Workshop I
nodes.effect: Passive. Learn two ordinary recipes from Bound Torches, Fletched Ammunition, Travel Food, Twisted Cord and Wooden Brace. With tools, work at the recipe’s interval and roll Knowledge for 1/2/3 progress toward its target, or 1/2/3 inventory steps if it produces a supply. Use its ingredients and output cap.

nodes.name: Trail Workshop II
nodes.effect: Trail Workshop teaches two additional recipes from that list.

nodes.name: Trail Workshop III
nodes.effect: Trail Workshop adds 1/3/4 progress or inventory steps instead of 1/2/3 when making those recipes. Output caps still apply.

nodes.name: Make Do
nodes.effect: 10 minutes · Knowledge, with tools and suitable salvage. Improvise one ordinary hook, wedge, lever or similar simple tool; add 1/2/3 progress toward target 3. It lasts for one task. This cannot create weapons, armor, consumable ingredients or valuables.

nodes.name: Raise a Frame I
nodes.effect: 1 hour · Knowledge, with tools and structural materials. Build a nonmagical brace, barricade or shelter; add 1/2/3 progress toward the DA’s construction objective. Fix size, strength and material requirements before work.

nodes.name: Raise a Frame II
nodes.effect: Raise a Frame adds 1/3/4 progress instead of 1/2/3.

nodes.name: Raise a Frame III
nodes.effect: Raise a Frame takes 30 minutes per attempt instead of 1 hour.

nodes.name: A Roof before Nightfall
nodes.effect: 1 hour, with tools and enough sound materials. Build a weatherproof shelter for six people on stable ground. No roll. It resists ordinary weather, not attacks or extreme hazards; the location must still be safe for overnight recovery.

nodes.name: Smoke in a Bottle I
nodes.effect: 1 hour · Knowledge, with alchemical tools and one purchased batch of smoke ingredients. Add 1/2/3 progress toward target 3 to prepare one smoke flask. Main Action to throw within 4 squares: smoke fills a 1-square-radius area until your next turn ends; sight through it is blocked.

nodes.name: Smoke in a Bottle II
nodes.effect: Smoke in a Bottle flasks have throwing range 6 squares instead of 4.

nodes.name: Smoke in a Bottle III
nodes.effect: Smoke in a Bottle flasks last until the end of your second turn after throwing instead of your next turn.

nodes.name: Screen the Retreat
nodes.effect: Main Action. Throw two prepared Smoke in a Bottle flasks at separate points within their range. Resolve each normally. Consume both prepared flasks.

nodes.name: Scholarship
nodes.effect: Ask the question that turns an old fact into a useful one.

nodes.name: Recall the Record I
nodes.effect: 1 minute · Knowledge. Examine a subject or reliable description; add 1/2/3 progress toward recalling a relevant fact. Before rolling, name the question and the DA sets its objective. You cannot retry unchanged evidence after completion.

nodes.name: Recall the Record II
nodes.effect: Recall the Record adds 1/3/4 progress instead of 1/2/3.

nodes.name: Recall the Record III
nodes.effect: Recall the Record takes a Main Action per attempt instead of 1 minute.

nodes.name: Name the Weakness
nodes.effect: Maneuver. After you identify a creature’s documented weakness through Recall the Record, tell up to three allies within 6 squares. Each gains 1 Boon on its next attack against that creature before your next turn ends. Once per creature per encounter.

nodes.name: Read the Evidence I
nodes.effect: 10 minutes · Reason. Examine a scene without disturbing it; add 1/2/3 progress toward answering one concrete question about its physical evidence. The DA sets the objective and identifies what access is required.

nodes.name: Read the Evidence II
nodes.effect: Read the Evidence adds 1/3/4 progress instead of 1/2/3.

nodes.name: Read the Evidence III
nodes.effect: Read the Evidence takes 5 minutes per attempt instead of 10.

nodes.name: Reconstruct the Scene
nodes.effect: 10 minutes · Reason. At a scene already investigated, add 1/2/3 progress toward reconstructing the order of up to three related events. On completion, the DA distinguishes supported conclusions from gaps; this reveals no unseen thoughts.

nodes.name: Patient Translation I
nodes.effect: 10 minutes · Knowledge, with a glossary or parallel text. Add 1/2/3 progress toward translating one short passage in an unfamiliar nonmagical language. No reference means no attempt; ciphers need their own objective.

nodes.name: Patient Translation II
nodes.effect: Patient Translation adds 1/3/4 progress instead of 1/2/3.

nodes.name: Patient Translation III
nodes.effect: Patient Translation takes 5 minutes per attempt instead of 10.

nodes.name: Bridge of Words
nodes.effect: 10 minutes with a willing speaker and usable shared signs or reference text. Establish simple communication about directions, quantities and immediate needs for this conversation. No roll; abstract bargains and hidden meanings still require translation.

nodes.name: Survey the Ground I
nodes.effect: 10 minutes · Reason. Inspect a visible site; add 1/2/3 progress toward identifying one usable approach and its visible hazards. The DA sets the objective; concealed threats require evidence to discover.

nodes.name: Survey the Ground II
nodes.effect: Survey the Ground adds 1/3/4 progress instead of 1/2/3.

nodes.name: Survey the Ground III
nodes.effect: Survey the Ground also reveals one feasible fallback route when its objective is completed, if any exists.

nodes.name: Prepared Retreat
nodes.effect: Maneuver. At a site you surveyed, direct up to three willing allies within 6 squares along the identified fallback route. Each immediately moves up to 2 squares without movement reactions. Once per encounter; blocked or changed routes provide no passage.

nodes.name: Influence
nodes.effect: Open a door, steady a friend or turn a room.

nodes.name: Make the Case I
nodes.effect: One exchange · Reason. Present a credible argument or offer to someone who can hear and understand you. Add 1/2/3 progress toward an agreed social objective; the DA judges whether the approach applies.

nodes.name: Make the Case II
nodes.effect: Make the Case adds 1/3/4 progress instead of 1/2/3.

nodes.name: Make the Case III
nodes.effect: Once per objective, presenting new evidence that directly addresses the listener’s stated concern adds 1 extra progress to Make the Case.

nodes.name: Common Ground
nodes.effect: One exchange · Reason. Propose terms to two willing negotiating sides that can hear you. Roll once and add 1/2/3 progress to each side’s separate acceptance objective. Each side still decides within its established boundaries.

nodes.name: Steady Voice I
nodes.effect: Maneuver. One willing ally within 4 squares who can hear you reduces Frightened by 1. No roll; it must understand your reassurance.

nodes.name: Steady Voice II
nodes.effect: Steady Voice reduces Frightened by 2 instead of 1.

nodes.name: Steady Voice III
nodes.effect: Steady Voice can affect two willing allies within range instead of one.

nodes.name: Rally the Line
nodes.effect: Main Action. Up to four willing allies within 6 squares who can hear and understand you reduce Frightened by 2 and may each move 1 square toward you. This movement does not trigger reactions.

nodes.name: Plausible Story I
nodes.effect: One exchange · Guile. Offer a plausible false account to listeners who understand you; add 1/2/3 progress toward a defined deception objective. Contradictory proof or impossible claims can make the objective unavailable.

nodes.name: Plausible Story II
nodes.effect: Plausible Story adds 1/3/4 progress instead of 1/2/3.

nodes.name: Plausible Story III
nodes.effect: Once per objective, a relevant prepared prop or corroborating witness adds 1 extra progress to Plausible Story.

nodes.name: Hold Their Attention
nodes.effect: One exchange · Guile. Engage up to three listeners in a plausible distraction; add 1/2/3 progress toward holding their attention for one minute. Completion gives allies 1 Boon on unnoticed tasks outside those listeners’ direct sight for that minute.

nodes.name: Draw the Line I
nodes.effect: One exchange · Brawn. State a credible immediate consequence that you can carry out; add 1/2/3 progress toward a limited concession. The listener must perceive and understand the threat. The DA determines its credibility.

nodes.name: Draw the Line II
nodes.effect: Draw the Line adds 1/3/4 progress instead of 1/2/3.

nodes.name: Draw the Line III
nodes.effect: Once per objective, demonstrating the threatened capability without attacking the listener adds 1 extra progress to Draw the Line.

nodes.name: Terms of Surrender
nodes.effect: Main Action · Reason. Offer a feasible surrender to up to three enemies who understand you. Roll once; add 1/2/3 progress to their shared objective if they share a motive, otherwise one chosen enemy’s objective. They do not stop fighting before completion.

nodes.name: Elements
nodes.effect: Shape the physical world: heat, water, stone and air.

nodes.name: Life
nodes.effect: Restore, transform, cultivate and unravel living things.

nodes.name: Mentalism
nodes.effect: Thought, feeling, perception and the dreaming mind.

nodes.name: Divination
nodes.effect: Find what is hidden across distance, history and possibility.

nodes.name: Invocation
nodes.effect: Contact beings, establish bonds and cross boundaries.

nodes.name: Force
nodes.effect: Move, shape, animate and enchant the material world.

nodes.name: Wards
nodes.effect: Protect people and places; secure and unravel magic.

nodes.name: Spellcraft
nodes.effect: Study your reserves, restore your focus, and channel magical power.

nodes.name: Soul Capacity I
nodes.effect: Maximum SP +2.

nodes.name: Soul Capacity II
nodes.effect: Maximum SP +2.

nodes.name: Soul Capacity III
nodes.effect: Maximum SP +3.

nodes.name: Soul Capacity IV
nodes.effect: Maximum SP +3. Total branch gain: +10 SP.

nodes.name: Mind Capacity I
nodes.effect: Maximum SP +2.

nodes.name: Mind Capacity II
nodes.effect: Maximum SP +2.

nodes.name: Mind Capacity III
nodes.effect: Maximum SP +3.

nodes.name: Mind Capacity IV
nodes.effect: Maximum SP +3. Total branch gain: +10 SP.

nodes.name: Recovery I
nodes.effect: 1 uninterrupted hour of safe rest, meditation or quiet leisure. Once between safe overnight rests, recover 1 SP, never above maximum.

nodes.name: Recovery II
nodes.effect: This same recovery restores 2 SP in total. Use this benefit during your one recovery rest between safe overnight rests.

nodes.name: Recovery III
nodes.effect: This same recovery restores 3 SP in total. Use this benefit during your one recovery rest between safe overnight rests.

nodes.name: Recovery IV
nodes.effect: This same recovery restores 4 SP in total. Use this benefit during your one recovery rest between safe overnight rests.

nodes.name: Iron Tempest
nodes.effect: Main Action · Brawn, wearing armor and wielding a melee weapon. Move up to 3 squares, ignoring extra movement cost from difficult terrain, and attack up to three enemies adjacent at any point along that route. Roll once; each takes 3/5/8 physical damage. Each target is struck once. Movement reactions resolve normally. This is a new attack; Measured Cut improvements do not apply.

nodes.name: Shatter the Formation
nodes.effect: Main Action · Brawn, with a melee weapon and shield. Attack up to three adjacent enemies. Roll once; each takes 2/4/6 physical damage and is pushed up to 2 squares directly away. On Strong, each also becomes Prone. Blocked movement stops the push; it does not cancel damage or Prone. Do not also resolve Battering Stroke or Shield Bash.

nodes.name: The Unbroken Gate
nodes.effect: Main Action, wearing armor and holding a shield. Hold your ground until your next turn starts: you cannot move or be moved. When an attacker first chooses an adjacent ally as the sole target of an attack, you may take its place before the roll if you are a legal target. Resolve the attack against you with the usual single roll. These interceptions require no Reaction. Apply the usual damage rules to the new target.

nodes.name: The Last Safe Step
nodes.effect: Reaction. When an ally within 4 squares is about to take damage from an attack or fall, move up to 4 squares along a legal route to reach it. Neither of you triggers movement reactions during this rescue. If you reach it, move together up to 2 more squares and reduce that damage by 4. Apply the usual minimum for attacks. An attack still resolves against its original target. A fall ends only if the destination supports both creatures.

nodes.name: Anatomist’s Volley
nodes.effect: Main Action · Agility, with a ranged weapon. Attack up to three visible enemies within 12 squares whose weaknesses you identified with Recall the Record. Spend one projectile per target and roll once; each takes 3/5/8 physical damage, ignoring up to 2 physical resistance. Other reductions apply normally. This ability does not reveal weaknesses or share its damage benefit with other attacks.

nodes.name: Steel across the Gap
nodes.effect: Main Action · Agility, with a thrown weapon. Jump up to 4 squares to a visible legal landing without triggering movement reactions. At any point during the jump, throw the weapon at up to two visible enemies within 6 squares of you and 2 squares of each other. Roll once; each takes 3/5/7 physical damage. The weapon lands beside the second target, or the only target if there is one.

nodes.name: Silent Entry
nodes.effect: 1 minute · Guile, with lock tools and repair tools. Work on one reachable nonmagical door, lock or mechanical fastening. Add 3/5/7 progress toward opening it without visible damage; the DA sets the objective. On completion, you may close it afterward so it appears undisturbed to casual inspection. This neither suppresses a separate alarm nor bypasses a trap; those remain separate tasks.

nodes.name: The Perfect Substitution
nodes.effect: One exchange · Guile. Engage a listener who understands you while exchanging one accessible palm-sized object within reach for a similar object you carry. Roll once and add 2/4/6 progress to both the deception and unnoticed-exchange objectives, each set separately by the DA. The exchange occurs only when its own objective completes. Held weapons, worn armor and secured containers cannot be exchanged.

nodes.name: Read the Killing Ground
nodes.effect: 10 minutes · Reason. Examine a visible area up to 6 squares across; add 3/5/7 progress toward identifying its accessible nonmagical traps, their triggers and a safe route through them. At completion, the DA identifies all supported findings and any inaccessible gaps. You and companions following your exact instructions can traverse the identified route without triggering those traps while their arrangement remains unchanged.

nodes.name: Shelter against the Siege
nodes.effect: 1 hour, with tools and enough timber, stone or other sound materials. Build a concealed fortified shelter for up to eight people on stable ground. No roll. Occupants behind its walls gain 2 Boons on defense against attacks from outside; each door or wall section has 15 HP and physical resistance 2. Every damaging attack against a section deals at least 1. The shelter offers no protection through an open door and does not automatically make overnight rest safe.

nodes.name: A Way through Death
nodes.effect: Main Action · Knowledge, wearing armor and carrying medical supplies. Move up to 3 squares to a willing or helpless creature no larger than you. Restore 5/8/11 HP using its available first-aid attempt, then carry it up to 3 squares to a legal destination. Both movements ignore movement reactions. You may perform the rescue without healing if its allowance is spent; this restores no HP and consumes no supplies.

nodes.name: A Treaty in Common Words
nodes.effect: 30 minutes · Reason. With willing representatives of up to three sides and a working language, interpreter or shared reference text, formulate one concrete agreement. Roll once and add 3/5/7 progress to each side’s separate acceptance objective. On each completion, the DA states that side’s commitments and known reservations plainly. No side is compelled to accept impossible terms, and the agreement creates no magical enforcement.

nodes.name: Break the Encirclement
nodes.effect: Main Action · Brawn, with a melee weapon and shield. Move up to 4 squares, including a jump up to 3 squares, without movement reactions. Attack up to four enemies adjacent at any point on the route. Roll once; each takes 3/6/9 physical damage and is pushed 1 square directly away from your attack position. Afterward, up to two willing allies within 3 squares of your destination may each move 2 squares without movement reactions.

nodes.name: The Moving Bulwark
nodes.effect: Main Action, wearing armor and holding a shield. Choose up to four willing allies within 3 squares who can hear you. You and each chosen ally may immediately move 2 squares without movement reactions. Until your next turn starts, chosen allies within 3 squares of you gain 1 Boon on defense and reduce attack damage by 3, minimum 1. You gain the same protection. Reusing this ability replaces its previous effect.

nodes.name: Hunt at the Crossroads
nodes.effect: 10 minutes. Prepare an ambush along a trail you have followed, at a site you have surveyed. Choose up to four willing allies and a visible trigger line up to 6 squares long. Once before the next safe overnight rest, when a tracked enemy crosses the line, you and each chosen ally may spend an available Reaction to make one known basic attack against it if in range. These attacks gain 1 Boon and +2 damage. The preparation ends if you leave the site.

nodes.name: The Hidden Road
nodes.effect: 1 hour · Agility, with rope and concealment materials. Establish a concealed route up to 20 squares long across terrain you can physically traverse; add 3/5/7 progress toward the DA’s route objective. On completion, up to six companions following your instructions can traverse it at normal movement cost with 2 Boons on rolls to remain unnoticed. It creates no bridge across unsupported space. Discovery or physical damage to the route ends these benefits until repaired.

nodes.name: The Field Hospital
nodes.effect: 30 minutes, with medical supplies and a safe, prepared shelter. Treat up to six willing creatures, each using its available first-aid attempt. Roll Knowledge once; each restores 5/8/11 HP and reduces temporary Bleeding or Poisoned by 2, choosing separately for each patient. A patient with a spent allowance receives condition care only. Supplies must cover every patient. This creates no extra healing allowance, SP recovery or overnight rest.

nodes.name: The Truth before the Council
nodes.effect: 10 minutes · Reason. Present a case supported by evidence you investigated, including a physical exhibit you can handle and demonstrate. Address up to four decision-makers who can understand you. Roll once; add 3/5/7 progress to each relevant acceptance objective. Each listener whose objective completes acknowledges the supported facts and grants the attainable concession agreed with the DA. This does not prove unsupported claims or reveal facts absent from the evidence.

nodes.name: The Day We Held
nodes.effect: Main Action · Brawn, with armor, a melee weapon and shield. Once per encounter, attack up to four adjacent enemies. Roll once; each takes 4/7/10 physical damage. Until your next turn starts, you cannot be forcibly moved, and you and up to four chosen allies within 3 squares reduce attack damage by 4, minimum 1. Each chosen ally may immediately move 2 squares toward you without movement reactions. This grants no extra attacks or Reactions.

nodes.name: Bring Everyone Home
nodes.effect: Main Action · Knowledge, with armor, a shield and medical supplies. Once per encounter, move up to 8 squares without movement reactions. Along the route, treat up to three different willing or helpless creatures within reach: each with an available first-aid attempt restores 5/8/11 HP from one shared roll and spends that attempt. Carry one creature no larger than you along any part of the route without added encumbrance. Healing cannot exceed maximum HP or restore a spent allowance.

nodes.name: A City Opens Its Gates
nodes.effect: 1 day · Reason. Through an on-site demonstration of a feasible civic project, broker an agreement among up to four willing factions with whom you can communicate. Use a visible model or working example built with real materials; do not invent resources. Roll once; add 4/7/10 progress to each faction’s separate agreement objective. Completion secures the specific commitments the DA established, such as access, labor or a ceasefire. New terms or changed circumstances need a new objective; this is not control over a settlement.

nodes.name: Stormsteel Arc
nodes.effect: Main Action · Brawn · 3 SP, with a melee weapon. Sweep lightning through up to three visible enemies within 3 squares. Roll once; each takes 3/6/9 lightning damage. On Strong, each also gains Dazed 1. This is a new magical attack, not a use of Measured Cut; its improvements do not apply.

nodes.name: The Invisible Shieldbearer
nodes.effect: Reaction · 2 SP, with a held shield. When an ally within 8 squares is about to take damage from an attack, project a force barrier to it. Reduce that attack’s damage by 4, minimum 1, then move the willing ally up to 2 squares along a legal route without movement reactions. This protects against one attack only and requires no additional roll.

nodes.name: Borrowed Dawn
nodes.effect: Main Action · Knowledge · 4 SP. Restore 8/12/16 HP to one living willing or helpless creature within reach. Also reduce its Bleeding by 2. This is magical healing, not first aid: it neither spends nor refreshes the recipient’s first-aid allowance. It cannot raise the dead, restore Grit or exceed maximum HP.

nodes.name: Starfall Volley
nodes.effect: Main Action · Agility · 4 SP, with a ranged weapon. Attack up to three visible enemies within 12 squares whose weaknesses you identified with Recall the Record. Spend one projectile per target and roll once; each takes 4/7/10 fire damage and Burning 1. Each target is struck once; allies and other creatures nearby are unaffected. This grants no bonus to other attacks.

nodes.name: Step Between Heartbeats
nodes.effect: Main Action · Agility · 4 SP, with a melee weapon. Teleport to a visible unoccupied square within 10 squares, then attack one adjacent creature for 4/7/10 physical damage. After the attack, teleport up to 4 squares to another visible legal destination. Neither teleport triggers movement reactions. If you finish behind cover that conceals you from every enemy, become Hidden. An explicit teleportation barrier can block either movement.

nodes.name: Sanctuary of Steel
nodes.effect: Main Action · 4 SP, wearing armor and holding a shield. Create a fixed sanctuary within 3 squares of your position until your next turn ends. You and up to four chosen allies inside it reduce attack damage by 4, minimum 1, and cannot gain Frightened or Dazed while inside. Existing conditions remain. Leaving ends a creature’s protection until it returns; the boundary blocks neither movement nor attacks. Recasting replaces your previous sanctuary.

nodes.name: Colossus of the Forge
nodes.effect: Main Action · Knowledge · 6 SP, with a melee weapon. Form an incandescent shell around yourself through the end of your next turn, then immediately sweep up to four enemies within 3 squares for 4/7/10 physical damage and Burning 1, using one roll. While the shell lasts, gain Stability 3 and reduce attack damage by 3, minimum 1. On your next turn, you may spend a Main Action to repeat that sweep without additional SP. The shell cannot stack with another copy and creates no lasting material.

nodes.name: The Road for the Lost
nodes.effect: Ritual · 10 minutes · 6 SP. Open a visible passage from your position to a landmark on the same plane within 100 squares that you personally visited and surveyed. Both endpoints must have safe, unoccupied footing. Up to twelve willing creatures you name may cross during the next minute; no other creature or attack can pass through it. You may close it early. It transports carried belongings but no unattended freight. Teleportation barriers block the working; it does not bypass an unknown destination or create safe ground.

nodes.name: Dawn on the Battlefield
nodes.effect: Main Action · Knowledge · 6 SP. Choose up to six living willing or helpless allies within 6 squares whom you can see. Roll once; each restores 6/10/14 HP and reduces Bleeding and Frightened by 2 each. A helpless ally need not respond to be included. This is magical healing and neither uses nor refreshes first-aid allowances. It cannot raise the dead, restore Grit or exceed maximum HP. Each recipient is affected once per use.

nodes.name: Meteor Swarm
nodes.effect: Main Action · Knowledge · 6 SP. Choose up to three visible points within 12 squares. Roll once; every creature within 1 square of a chosen point takes 4/7/10 fire damage. A creature in overlapping areas takes damage once. Allies are not exempt. Unattended flammable objects ignite. This is one spell, not three separate castings.

nodes.name: Wall of Thorns — Living Fortress
nodes.effect: Main Action · Reason · 5 SP. Raise up to eight connected thorn-wall squares on unoccupied ground within 8 squares. The walls last 10 minutes, are 2 squares high, block movement and provide cover. Name up to six creatures when casting; each may pass through at normal movement cost. Other creatures can spend a Main Action cutting through one adjacent square with a suitable edged tool, taking 3 physical damage before resistance. Fire destroys an affected wall square after that attack resolves. No roll.

nodes.name: True Resurrection
nodes.effect: Ritual · 8 uninterrupted hours · Reason · 8 SP, with remains of one person dead no longer than seven days and unique funerary materials worth 500 coins. The DA establishes availability before preparation. The spirit must freely agree. At completion, consume the materials and return that person to life at 1 HP in a restored body, clearing both death roll tallies but retaining descriptive scars. No roll. No duplicate body, restored Grit or SP is created. Each person has one lifetime return to life, shared with Lifegiving and Mass Lifegiving. This ritual restores a life ended before its natural span.

nodes.name: Simulacrum
nodes.effect: Ritual · 8 uninterrupted hours · Knowledge · 8 SP, with a willing adjacent living model and sculpting materials worth 300 coins, consumed on completion. Create one likeness with 10 HP, no SP or Grit, your Speed, and the model’s appearance and voice. It lasts until destroyed or you create another. It cannot cast, use learned abilities or recover HP. On your turn, spend a Main Action to command it to move up to its Speed and perform an ordinary task or Basic Melee attack using your Knowledge and 2/3/5 damage. It has no independent actions or Reactions; you roll its defenses with your attributes. It cannot create a duplicate. Destroying it does not harm the model.

nodes.name: Demiplane
nodes.effect: Ritual · 1 hour · Knowledge · 6 SP. Open a doorway on an adjacent solid wall to your private 6-by-6-square refuge, 3 squares high. The doorway lasts 10 minutes and may be used by anyone who can reach it. You may close it with a Maneuver. A Maneuver inside opens an exit to the last entrance location; if obstructed, use the nearest unoccupied square within 3 squares. The refuge holds ordinary objects and up to twelve creatures, with air and normal time but no created food or water. You have one refuge; recasting reopens it from the new wall. It grants no travel to any other destination. No roll.

nodes.name: Foresight — Shared Vigil
nodes.effect: Ritual · 10 minutes · Reason · 5 SP. Link yourself and up to three willing creatures within 3 squares for one hour. Linked creatures within 12 squares of you receive a warning when any linked member perceives a threat. If the warning alerts the group before the attack, roll initiative normally. Once each round, after one linked creature rolls a defense, it may reroll the entire roll and keep either result. The entire group shares this one reroll. The link carries warnings, not unrestricted thoughts. Recasting replaces the previous link. No roll.

nodes.name: Storm of Vengeance
nodes.effect: Main Action · Reason · 7 SP. Choose a visible point within 12 squares and a 1-square sanctuary within 2 squares of that point. For three rounds, a storm fills a 3-square radius around the point. When cast, roll once: creatures in the storm outside the sanctuary take 3/5/7 lightning damage. At the start of your next two turns, spend your Main Action and roll again to continue it, dealing the same damage and pushing each affected creature 1 square away from the center where legal. If you cannot or do not spend the action, the storm ends. Everyone in the sanctuary is exempt. Recasting ends the earlier storm.

nodes.name: Mass Lifegiving
nodes.effect: Ritual · 1 uninterrupted hour · Reason · 10 SP, within a safe prepared sanctuary. Choose up to three willing dead people whose bodies are present and who died within the previous hour. Consume 200 coins of consecrated materials for each; the DA establishes availability beforehand. Restore their fatal injuries, return them to life at 1 HP and clear both death roll tallies. No roll. Scars remain; SP and Grit are not restored. Each person has one lifetime return to life, shared with Lifegiving and True Resurrection.

nodes.name: Foresight — Oracle’s Dream
nodes.effect: Ritual · 1 hour of shared sleep · Reason · 6 SP. You and up to three willing nearby sleepers seek the help of a willing spirit for one named undertaking in the next 24 hours. The DA gives one truthful warning of a foreseeable obstacle and one usable clue about addressing it, subject to the spirit’s knowledge. Each dreamer may once reroll an entire roll directly addressing the undertaking and keep either result. Unused rerolls expire after 24 hours; a creature cannot hold a benefit from more than one Oracle’s Dream. No casting roll. This does not guarantee success or reveal unknowable future decisions.

nodes.name: Gate — World Anchor
nodes.effect: Ritual · 7 days, 8 hours of work per day · Knowledge · 10 SP on each workday, with prepared stone anchors at two known locations, each accessible during preparation, and 1,000 coins of materials consumed in total. The DA establishes availability and site permissions first. Create a permanent paired gateway, 2 squares wide, between those anchors, even across planes. At an anchor, a holder of either of the two keys you create can spend a Main Action and 3 SP to open both ends for 10 minutes, or a Maneuver to close them. Anyone can pass while open. A key conveys no control over travelers. Destroying either anchor ends the connection; each has 30 HP and physical resistance 3, and always takes at least 1 attack damage. No roll. You may maintain one pair; completing another ends the first.

nodes.name: Guards and Wards — Living Citadel
nodes.effect: Ritual · 3 days, 8 hours of work per day · Reason · 10 SP each day, with sound stone, fertile soil, water and 600 coins of materials consumed. On a prepared 12-by-12-square site, raise a one-story living keep with six rooms, a courtyard, a gate and walls 3 squares high. No roll. Walls block movement and sight; each 1-square section has 20 HP and physical resistance 3, with minimum 1 attack damage. You designate up to twelve residents. At dawn, paying 4 SP renews its wards for 24 hours: residents within gain 1 Boon to defenses, and you sense the location of any breached wall while inside. Missing upkeep removes the wards, not the building. The keep needs ordinary food, water and repairs. You may ward only one citadel at a time.

nodes.name: Another Tongue
nodes.duration: Permanent knowledge of the chosen language.
nodes.limits: Purchase once; choose one language when learned.
nodes.effect:
**Action:** Passive · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self

When you learn this ability, choose one ordinary language you do not already know. You can speak and understand it, and read and write its usual script if it has one. Record the language on your sheet. A signed language uses signing instead of speech. Choose from the campaign's ordinary languages with the DA. Secret and supernatural languages are learned through their own paths.

**Duration:** Permanent knowledge of the chosen language.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

flavor: Learn one ordinary language when you take this ability, including its usual script if it has one.

**Duration:** Until the end of this turn; unused movement expires.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

nodes.name: Catch That!
nodes.target: One falling, unattended item in your square or an adjacent square, within reach, before it lands or falls out of reach.
nodes.limits: Purchase once; each use spends your Reaction.
nodes.effect:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One falling, unattended item in your square or an adjacent square, within reach, before it lands or falls out of reach.

Catch the item in a free hand. The item must be small enough to hold in that hand. The ability catches falling objects; attacks and items held by another creature follow their own rules.

**Duration:** Instant.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

flavor: Your hand darts out to catch a falling object before it hits the ground.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One falling, unattended item in your square or an adjacent square, within reach, before it lands or falls out of reach.

details.label: Limits

# Catch That!

*Your hand darts out to catch a falling object before it hits the ground.*

## Rules

**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One falling, unattended item in your square or an adjacent square, within reach, before it lands or falls out of reach.

Catch the item in a free hand. The item must be small enough to hold in that hand. The ability catches falling objects; attacks and items held by another creature follow their own rules.

**Duration:** Instant.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

---

**Tier / minimum level:** 0 · **DP:** 1 · **Requirements to learn:** None

**Type:** Utility

**Tags:** Universal / Reaction / Skill

**Limits:** Purchase once; each use spends your Reaction.

**ID:** catch-that

nodes.name: Message by Heart
nodes.target: One message of up to 50 words that you can hear, or read in a script you know.
nodes.duration: Until you memorize a replacement message.
nodes.limits: Purchase once; one retained message at a time.
nodes.effect:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Time:** One minute of rehearsal.

**Target / range / shape:** One message of up to 50 words that you can hear, or read in a script you know.

After rehearsing the message for one minute, you can reproduce its words exactly from memory. You may retain unfamiliar words this way without understanding them. You can retain one message at a time; memorizing another replaces it. Recalling the stored message takes only the normal time to speak or write it. Translation and understanding come from your own knowledge or other abilities.

**Duration:** Until you memorize a replacement message.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

nodes.target: Self, while playing your chosen instrument.
nodes.duration: While you play the chosen instrument.
nodes.equipment: Requires an ordinary Musical Instrument (Bulk 1), chosen when you learn this ability; grants none.
nodes.limits: Purchase once; choose one instrument when learned.
nodes.effect:
**Action:** Passive · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self, while playing your chosen instrument.

When you learn this ability, choose one ordinary instrument you own, such as a lute, flute, drum, fiddle or horn. While you play that instrument, gain 1 Boon to any Guile roll. The instrument must be in your hands and in playing condition. The Boon can support performance, persuasion, deception and other Guile approaches that the music carries. Ordinary performance remains available to everyone; a performance with no uncertain consequence needs no roll.

**Duration:** While you play the chosen instrument.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Requires an ordinary Musical Instrument (Bulk 1), chosen when you learn this ability; grants none.

books.name: Ormund’s Codex of Stone & Deep Places
Serevan’s Book of Restoration
books.theme: Repair the body without bypassing recovery limits.

books.name: Ilyra’s Book of Thought
books.theme: Communication and bounded access to thought.

books.name: Ilyra’s Book of Emotion
books.theme: Influence feelings without dictating every decision.

books.name: Ilyra’s Book of Perception
books.theme: Illusions experienced by minds, not physical matter.

books.name: Ilyra’s Book of Dreams
books.theme: Sleep, dreams and their remembered impressions.

books.name: Orren’s Book of Farseeing
books.theme: Observe beyond ordinary reach through defined connections.

books.name: Orren’s Book of Echoes
books.theme: Read traces left by past events.

books.name: Vaelis’s Book of Spirits
books.theme: Contact incorporeal beings and understand hauntings.

books.name: Mordain’s Book of Shaping
books.theme: Reshape and repair existing nonliving material.

books.name: Mordain’s Book of Animation
books.theme: Give objects movement and bounded instructions.

books.name: Edris’s Book of Protection
books.theme: Protect an individual creature or object.

books.name: Edris’s Book of Sanctuary
books.theme: Protect places and establish safe boundaries.

books.name: Edris’s Book of Seals
books.theme: Secure doors, containers and magical workings.

books.name: Talven’s Book of Channeling
books.theme: Draw, give and redirect magical power between existing reserves. Casting costs are paid separately from the points you transfer.

spells.name: Fire Bolt
spells.target: One creature within 8 squares
spells.effect: Hurl a bright ember. Deal 2/3/5 fire damage.

spells.name: Boil Liquid
spells.target: One unattended container within 1 square; up to 10 liters
spells.effect: Bring its liquid to a rolling boil. The liquid then cools naturally; handle it with suitable protection.

spells.name: Burning Hands
spells.target: Every creature in a 3-square cone from you
spells.effect: Sweep your hands outward in a fan of flame. Deal 2/3/5 fire damage to each creature in the cone.

spells.name: Heat Metal
spells.target: One visible metal item worn or held within 6 squares
spells.effect: Heat the item until it glows. Its wearer or holder takes 2/3/5 fire damage when cast. Each later round you sustain it, roll again and deal the same damage if it is still touching a creature. A holder may drop it immediately after damage; worn items take their normal removal time.

spells.name: Scorching Ray
spells.target: Up to three creatures within 8 squares
spells.effect: Loose three fiery rays. Roll once for a shared total of 4/6/9 fire damage. Divide that total between the chosen targets before resistance, assigning at least 1 to each. Each target takes one damage event.

spells.name: Wall of Fire
spells.target: A line of six connected unoccupied squares within 8 squares
spells.effect: Raise a wall of flame 2 squares high. Roll when cast to set its fire damage at 3/5/7. A creature takes that damage the first time each round it enters the wall or ends its turn there. Treat each creature once per round across all squares of this wall.

spells.name: Fireball
spells.target: Every creature in a 2-square-radius burst centered within 10 squares
spells.effect: A bead of fire bursts into a roaring sphere. Deal 3/5/8 fire damage to every creature in the burst, including allies. Exposed unattended flammable material ignites.

spells.name: Fire Shield
spells.target: Self
spells.effect: Wreathe yourself in protective heat. Gain cold resistance 2. A creature that damages you with an adjacent melee attack takes 2 fire damage after its attack resolves, once per attacker per round.

spells.name: Fire Storm
spells.target: Every creature in up to six connected squares within 10 squares
spells.effect: Trace a winding furnace across the battlefield. Deal 4/7/10 fire damage to each creature in the chosen squares. Each creature is affected once; exposed unattended flammable objects ignite.

spells.name: Delayed Blast Fireball
spells.target: One visible point within 10 squares; 2-square-radius burst
spells.effect: Place a glowing bead at the point. On casting, or after a later upkeep, you may detonate it. Roll on detonation for 4/6/9 fire damage, adding 1 damage per completed upkeep, maximum +2. Ending sustain or touching the bead detonates it immediately. Every creature in the burst is affected once.

spells.name: Incendiary Cloud
spells.target: A 2-square-radius cloud centered within 8 squares
spells.effect: Fill the area with opaque, burning smoke. Roll when cast to set fire damage at 3/5/7. Creatures in it immediately take that damage. Thereafter a creature takes it on first entering or ending its turn there, at most once each round. Each upkeep may move the cloud's center up to 2 squares.

spells.name: Ray of Frost
spells.target: One creature within 8 squares
spells.effect: Send a needle of frost into the target. Deal 2/3/5 cold damage.

spells.name: Create or Destroy Water
spells.target: An unattended open container or ground within 1 square
spells.effect: Create up to 10 liters of ordinary clean water or remove that quantity of free-standing water. Water inside living creatures and sealed vessels stays unchanged.

spells.name: Purify Food and Drink
spells.target: Up to six meals and 10 liters of drinking water within 1 square
spells.effect: Remove ordinary spoilage, poison and disease from the chosen food and drink. The purified provisions remain subject to later contamination.

spells.name: Water Breathing
spells.target: Up to three willing creatures within 3 squares
spells.effect: Give the recipients the ability to breathe water as readily as air. Their movement and pressure tolerance remain those of their bodies.

spells.name: Water Walk
spells.target: Up to three willing creatures within 3 squares
spells.effect: Let the recipients walk on calm or flowing liquid as though on firm ground, using normal movement. Waves and hazardous liquids retain their ordinary movement and damage effects. A recipient may end its own benefit with a Maneuver.

spells.name: Control Water
spells.target: A 4-by-4-square area of existing water within 8 squares, up to 2 squares deep
spells.effect: Part, raise or redirect the water by up to 2 squares. Each upkeep can reshape it within that area. Swimming creatures move with the flow up to 2 squares each upkeep; a creature holding a fixed support stays in place. Released water returns to its natural course.

spells.name: Ice Storm
spells.target: Every creature in a 2-square-radius burst within 10 squares
spells.duration: Instant; hail remains until your next turn ends
spells.effect: Hammer the area with sleet and hail. Deal 3/5/7 cold damage. The ground becomes difficult terrain until your next turn ends.

spells.name: Wall of Ice
spells.target: Six connected unoccupied squares within 8 squares
spells.effect: Raise a solid ice wall 2 squares high. Each square has 8 HP and physical resistance 1; fire damage uses its full value. A destroyed square opens a passage. Existing structures support the wall's weight.

spells.name: Cone of Cold
spells.target: Every creature in a 4-square cone from you
spells.effect: Release a roaring blast of winter. Deal 4/6/9 cold damage and apply Freezing 1 to each creature in the cone.

spells.name: Freezing Sphere
spells.target: Every creature in a 2-square-radius burst within 10 squares
spells.effect: Burst a globe of intense cold for 4/7/10 cold damage. Exposed surface water in the area freezes into a walkable crust; a creature can break one adjacent ice square with a Main Action and a suitable tool.

spells.name: Tsunami
spells.target: Every creature in a 5-square-wide, 3-square-long area within 8 squares
spells.effect: Raise a surging wave from nearby water or conjured spray. Deal 4/6/8 physical damage, push each affected creature 2 squares away from you, and make it Prone on Strong. Stability applies to the push; the water drains away after resolution.

spells.name: Enchanted Rope
spells.target: One unattended rope up to 6 squares long within 3 squares
spells.effect: Guide the rope's free end through a reachable opening and tie or undo one ordinary knot. It can secure itself to a suitable anchor. It bears its ordinary load and moves through unoccupied space.

spells.name: Loosen Earth
spells.target: One unoccupied square of loose earth within 3 squares, up to 1 square deep
spells.effect: Loosen, shift or pile the soil into an adjacent unoccupied square. Work around buried structures and roots. The resulting earth is ordinary material.

spells.name: Earthwall
spells.target: Three connected unoccupied ground squares within 6 squares
spells.effect: Raise a bank of packed earth 1 square high. It provides cover and costs 2 movement to climb. Each bank square has 6 HP and physical resistance 1.

spells.name: Cracks Call
spells.target: One visible unoccupied 2-square section of stone within 6 squares
spells.effect: Split ordinary stone along an existing weakness. Add 2/4/6 progress toward a DA-set demolition objective declared before casting. Creatures supported by collapsing stone may use their normal falling responses. Magical barriers use their own removal procedures.

spells.name: Meld into Stone
spells.target: Self; one adjacent natural stone mass large enough to hold you
spells.effect: Step inside the stone with your carried gear. You can hear muffled sounds and may emerge from your entry face with a Maneuver. While inside, rest and observe; manipulating the outside world requires emerging. If the stone is broken apart, emerge into the nearest open square and take 3 physical damage.

spells.name: Stone Shape
spells.target: One adjacent unattended stone mass, up to one square in each dimension
spells.effect: Reshape existing stone into a doorway, trough, steps or similarly simple form. Preserve its volume and structural support. Fine mechanisms require ordinary finishing work.

spells.name: Stoneskin
spells.target: One willing creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: Harden the recipient's skin like weathered granite. It gains physical resistance 2, using the highest matching resistance.

spells.name: Wall of Stone
spells.target: Six connected unoccupied squares on solid ground within 8 squares
spells.effect: Raise a stone wall 2 squares high. Each section has 12 HP and physical resistance 2. It can include openings you shape when casting. At expiry the conjured stone crumbles into harmless dust.

spells.name: Move Earth
spells.target: A 10-by-10-square patch of soil within 12 squares
spells.effect: Grade, trench or mound earth by up to 2 squares of depth or height. Shift it within the chosen patch, preserving volume. Move exposed loose soil around foundations rather than carrying buildings or creatures with it.

spells.name: Flesh to Stone
spells.target: One creature within 6 squares
spells.duration: Until the end of your next turn; conditions then decay normally
spells.effect: Stone creeps across the target. Apply Slowed 2/3/4. On Strong also apply Paralyzed 1. A second Strong casting while this spell's Slowed remains makes the target Petrified for 1 minute. Remove Curse, Greater Restoration or the caster's Maneuver ends that petrification.

spells.name: Earthquake
spells.target: Every grounded creature in a 3-square-radius area within 10 squares
spells.effect: Shake the ground violently. Deal 4/6/8 physical damage and make affected creatures Prone. Add 2/4/6 progress toward one visible structure's DA-set collapse objective in the area; the DA describes unstable features before the roll.

spells.name: Elementalism — Air
spells.target: One unattended object of Bulk 0 within 3 squares
spells.effect: Stir a light breeze to turn pages, scatter loose dust, ring a small chime or move the object 1 square along a surface. The breeze can extinguish a candle-sized flame.

spells.name: Feather Fall
spells.actionText: Reaction · when a creature begins falling
spells.target: One visible creature within 6 squares
spells.duration: Until it lands, up to 1 minute
spells.effect: A cushion of air slows the descent to 2 squares each round. The recipient lands upright and unharmed from this fall if the destination supports it.

spells.name: Fog Cloud
spells.target: A 2-square-radius cloud centered within 6 squares
spells.effect: Gather an opaque bank of fog that blocks sight through its area. Strong wind disperses the cloud. Creatures may navigate by other senses and remembered positions.

spells.name: Gust of Wind
spells.target: Every creature along a straight 6-square line from you
spells.effect: Drive a powerful gust along the line. Push each affected creature 1/2/3 squares away from you and disperse ordinary smoke or fog in the line. Stability applies to the push.

spells.name: Levitate
spells.target: Self or one willing creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: Lift the recipient up to 3 squares above its starting height. Each upkeep can raise or lower it 2 squares, keeping it within 6 squares of you. It can pull itself along reachable solid surfaces using movement. On expiry it descends safely up to 3 squares, then falls normally.

spells.name: Lightning Bolt
spells.target: Every creature along an 8-square line from you
spells.effect: Send a crackling stroke along the line. Deal 3/5/7 lightning damage to each creature, once each.

spells.name: Fly
spells.target: Self or one willing creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: The recipient flies using its normal Speed and movement. On expiry it descends safely up to 3 squares; remaining unsupported distance is a normal fall.

spells.name: Wind Wall
spells.target: Six connected unoccupied squares within 6 squares
spells.effect: Raise a wind barrier 3 squares high. Physical ranged attacks through it receive 2 Banes. The wall disperses ordinary airborne smoke and gas in its squares. Creatures pass through at an extra movement cost of 1 per wall square.

spells.name: Chain Lightning
spells.target: Up to four creatures within 10 squares; each within 3 squares of another target
spells.effect: Lightning leaps along your chosen chain. Roll once and deal 4/6/8 lightning damage to each target. Affect each creature once.

spells.name: Control Weather
spells.target: The open sky within 1 kilometer of your ritual site
spells.effect: Gradually change local weather over the casting hour: clear or gather clouds, bring ordinary rain or snow, or raise or calm strong wind. Choose one weather change. Seasonal temperatures and sound shelter remain relevant. The change creates ordinary weather rather than attack damage.

spells.name: Wind Walk
spells.target: Self and up to five willing creatures within 3 squares
spells.effect: Transform the company and carried gear into windborne mist. Each travels at Speed 12, can rise freely, and can speak to fellow travelers. Returning to solid form or mist takes 1 uninterrupted minute. While mist, use movement and observation; handling objects and casting require solid form. On expiry, choose the nearest safe ground within 6 squares.

spells.name: Spare the Dying
spells.target: One adjacent Dying creature
spells.effect: Steady the creature's breathing. Stabilize it at 0 HP and clear both death roll tallies, following the normal stabilization procedure.

spells.name: Cure Wounds
spells.target: One adjacent living creature
spells.effect: Close fresh injuries with a warm touch. Restore 3/5/7 HP, applying the recipient's Life resistance and maximum HP.

spells.name: Healing Word
spells.target: One living creature within 4 squares that can hear you
spells.effect: Speak a brief word of renewal. Restore 1/2/3 HP, applying Life resistance and maximum HP.

spells.name: Lesser Restoration
spells.target: One adjacent living creature
spells.effect: Choose Poisoned, Blinded or Deafened. Reduce its temporary rating by 1/2/3. This also treats a lasting instance whose source specifically names Lesser Restoration as its remedy.

spells.name: Prayer of Healing
spells.target: Up to six willing living creatures within 3 squares throughout the ritual
spells.effect: Guide a shared prayer of recovery. Roll once; each recipient restores 3/5/7 HP after Life resistance. Each creature can benefit from Prayer of Healing once between safe overnight rests.

spells.name: Mass Healing Word
spells.target: Up to three living creatures within 6 squares that can hear you
spells.effect: Send a restoring word through your companions. Roll once; each restores 2/3/5 HP after Life resistance.

spells.name: Greater Restoration
spells.target: One adjacent living creature
spells.effect: Choose one temporary condition; reduce it by 2/4/6. Alternatively, end one curse or lasting condition whose source names Greater Restoration as its remedy. That alternative is automatic and replaces the rolled reduction.

spells.name: Mass Cure Wounds
spells.target: Up to three living creatures within 6 squares
spells.effect: Weave wounds closed across a small company. Roll once; each restores 4/6/8 HP after Life resistance.

spells.name: Heal
spells.target: One living creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: Flood the recipient with restorative power. Restore 8/12/16 HP after Life resistance and reduce both Bleeding and Poisoned by 2.

spells.name: Regenerate
spells.target: One willing adjacent living creature throughout the ritual
spells.effect: Restore one missing nonvital limb or damaged ordinary sense, and restore 10 HP after Life resistance. The renewed part functions normally when the ritual finishes. Scars can remain as the player describes. This treats physical loss; curses use their named remedies.

spells.name: Mass Heal
spells.target: Up to six living creatures within 6 squares
spells.effect: Roll once for a shared healing total of 12/18/24 HP. Divide it among the chosen recipients, assigning at least 1 to each before Life resistance. Each recipient also reduces Bleeding by 2.

spells.name: Hues
spells.target: Self or one willing adjacent creature
spells.effect: Change the color and pattern of hair, skin or fur. Choose ordinary or vivid colors. The recipient retains its silhouette, voice and other identifying features.

spells.name: Jump
spells.target: One willing creature within 3 squares
spells.duration: Until the end of its next turn
spells.effect: The recipient's next jump can cover up to 4 squares horizontally or 2 vertically using its normal movement. Choose a reachable landing place and spend movement for the distance traveled.

spells.name: Longstrider
