spells.target: One willing creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: Increase the recipient's Speed by 2. Apply the highest magical Speed increase rather than adding repeated castings.

spells.name: Alter Self
spells.target: Self
spells.effect: Choose one adaptation: gills for water breathing, webbing for swimming at normal Speed, or a changed face and voice. Keep your size and attributes. Changing the chosen adaptation requires another casting.

spells.name: Enlarge/Reduce — Living
spells.target: One willing creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: Change its size by one category, Small to Medium or Medium to Large, or the reverse. Adjust occupied space to 1 or 2 squares on each side as appropriate. Enlarged creatures gain Stability 1; reduced creatures gain 1 Boon to moving through tight spaces. Equipment changes with the body; attacks retain their printed damage.

spells.name: Darkvision
spells.target: One willing creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: Give the recipient darkvision to 12 squares. It sees shapes in ordinary darkness; colors appear as shades of gray. Magical darkness follows its own visibility rules.

spells.name: Polymorph
spells.target: One willing creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: Give the recipient the body of a familiar ordinary Small or Medium animal. It keeps its HP, attributes and mind. Choose walking, swimming or climbing at its normal Speed; use claws or a bite for Basic Unarmed attacks. Worn gear merges into the form. Returning costs a Maneuver; speech, item use and casting resume in the original body.

spells.name: Freedom of Movement
spells.target: One willing creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: The recipient moves through nonmagical difficult terrain at ordinary cost and immediately reduces Slowed by 3. Once each turn it may spend a Maneuver to reduce Grappled by 2, using your movement magic to slip its bonds.

spells.name: Animal Shapes
spells.target: Up to three willing creatures within 6 squares
spells.effect: Transform each recipient using Polymorph's animal-form procedure. Choose a form and movement mode separately for each. Your single upkeep sustains the group. Each recipient may return to its original body with a Maneuver.

spells.name: Shapechange
spells.target: Self
spells.effect: Assume a familiar animal shape of Small, Medium or Large size. Keep your HP and attributes. Choose flying, swimming or climbing at your normal Speed, physical resistance 1, and a natural attack using Brawn or Agility for 3/5/7 physical damage. Your upkeep may change the form. Gear merges; return with a Maneuver to speak, use items or cast.

spells.name: True Polymorph — Living
spells.target: One willing adjacent creature; 100 coins of transformative incense consumed
spells.effect: Shape an ordinary living body of Small or Medium size: a humanoid guise or familiar animal. The recipient keeps its mind, HP and attributes. Choose one movement adaptation: swimming or climbing at normal Speed, or flight at Speed 4. Animal bodies use Polymorph's equipment and action rules. The recipient may return with a Maneuver; Greater Restoration also ends the transformation.

spells.name: Druidcraft
spells.target: One ordinary plant or patch of soil within 3 squares
spells.effect: Open a flower, ripen one already-growing fruit, make a seed sprout, or read whether rain is likely here in the next day. The growth affects one hand-sized part of the plant.

spells.name: Entangle
spells.target: Every grounded creature in a 2-square-radius area within 6 squares
spells.effect: Roots grasp through soil. Apply Slowed 1/2/3 to affected creatures. The area is difficult terrain while sustained. Each upkeep renews Slowed 1 on creatures still in the area; ordinary decay applies after they leave.

spells.name: Goodberry
spells.target: Up to six ordinary berries held by you
spells.effect: Each berry nourishes one creature for one meal when eaten. A berry is consumed by eating it and retains its ordinary Bulk. Food and hunger use this nourishment; HP recovery follows healing spells and treatment.

spells.name: Speak with Plants
spells.target: One ordinary plant within 1 square
spells.effect: Converse through impressions of light, weather, touch and nearby movement experienced during the past day. Ask up to three questions. The DA answers from what this plant could sense.

spells.name: Spike Growth
spells.target: A 2-square-radius patch of soil within 6 squares
spells.effect: Raise sharp growth that makes the area difficult terrain. Roll when cast to set physical damage at 2/3/5. Each creature takes that damage the first time each round it moves through at least one affected square. The growth is visible on inspection.

spells.name: Plant Growth
spells.target: A 6-by-6-square patch of existing ordinary vegetation within 6 squares
spells.effect: Thicken the plants into difficult terrain. You may leave a connected walking path clear when casting. Alternatively, tend the same area for healthy seasonal growth; that use improves its next ordinary harvest rather than creating immediate food.

spells.name: Tree Skin
spells.target: One willing creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: Bark covers the recipient's skin. Grant physical resistance 2 and Stability 1. Use the highest applicable resistance and Stability.

spells.name: Tree Stride
spells.target: Self; one adjacent living tree large enough to admit you
spells.effect: Step through the tree and emerge beside another living tree you can see within 12 squares. Carry your worn and held equipment. Choose an unoccupied destination with firm support.

spells.name: Awaken
spells.target: One willing ordinary animal or living tree beside you; 100 coins of rare incense consumed
spells.effect: Awaken a speaking mind with one language you know. The being keeps its body, natural senses and ordinary capabilities. It becomes an independent person; agree on any companionship or service through conversation. You can complete this awakening once between safe overnight rests.

spells.name: Wall of Thorns
spells.target: Six connected unoccupied ground squares within 8 squares
spells.effect: Grow a thorn wall 2 squares high. Moving through one square costs 3 movement and deals 3/5/7 physical damage, set by your casting roll, once per creature each round. Each wall square has 8 HP; fire damages it normally.

spells.name: Transport via Plants
spells.target: Self and up to five willing creatures beside a living tree
spells.effect: Travel through the tree to another living tree you personally touched within the past month, up to 10 kilometers away on the same plane. Everyone emerges in safe adjacent squares with carried gear. The destination tree must remain alive and large enough to admit a traveler.

spells.name: Poison Spray
spells.target: One living creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: Exhale a stinging spray. Deal 2/3/5 poison damage.

spells.name: Ray of Sickness
spells.target: One living creature within 6 squares
spells.effect: Strike with a sickly ray for 2/3/5 poison damage. On Strong also apply Poisoned 1.

spells.name: Ray of Enfeeblement
spells.target: One creature within 6 squares
spells.effect: Draw vigor from the target's muscles. Apply Slowed 1/2/3; on Strong also apply Dazed 1.

spells.name: Protection from Poison
spells.target: One willing creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: Grant poison resistance 2 and immediately reduce Poisoned by 2. Apply the highest matching resistance.

spells.name: Vampiric Touch
spells.target: One adjacent living creature
spells.effect: Take strength through a withering touch. Deal 2/4/6 life damage. Restore your HP by the damage actually dealt, up to 2/4/6, after applying your own Life resistance and maximum HP.

spells.name: Bestow Curse
spells.target: One creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: Speak a curse that burdens its efforts. Apply Poisoned 1/2/3, representing magical frailty. Each upkeep renews Poisoned 1. Remove Curse ends this curse and its remaining contribution immediately.

spells.name: Blight
spells.target: One living creature or plant within 8 squares
spells.effect: Wither flesh or foliage for 4/6/9 life damage. An ordinary unattended plant fitting within one square dries into brittle matter.

spells.name: Contagion
spells.target: One adjacent living creature
spells.effect: Inflict Poisoned 1/2/3*. This magical sickness persists at that rating until you end it with a Maneuver, Lesser Restoration treats it, or a successful 10-minute Knowledge treatment reaches 3 progress at 1/2/3 per attempt. It fades after 10 minutes in any case.

spells.name: Harm
spells.target: One living creature within 6 squares
spells.effect: Deal 5/8/11 life damage and apply Poisoned 1. Resolve damage and dying by the ordinary rules.

spells.name: Finger of Death
spells.target: One living creature within 8 squares
spells.effect: A black pulse strikes for 6/9/12 life damage. If the target reaches 0 HP, resolve its ordinary dying rules; the spell's damage is one event.

spells.name: Circle of Death
spells.target: Every living creature in a 3-square-radius burst within 10 squares
spells.effect: A ring of pallor spreads from the chosen point. Deal 4/6/8 life damage to each creature in the burst, including allies.

spells.name: Message
spells.target: One creature you can see within 6 squares
spells.effect: Whisper a message of up to ten words into the recipient's hearing. It may answer with up to ten words as part of the exchange. The message travels through ordinary ambient noise.

spells.name: Comprehend Languages
spells.target: Self; spoken words heard or writing touched
spells.effect: Understand the literal meaning of one language at a time. Read at an ordinary pace. Cultural references, ciphers and deliberate codes retain their own interpretation challenges.

spells.name: Detect Thoughts
spells.target: One creature within 3 squares that you can see
spells.effect: Read surface impressions. Learn 1/2/3 immediate concerns or sensory impressions, chosen by the DA for an NPC or its player for a hero. The target senses the intrusion after the reading. Deep memories use stronger workings.

spells.name: Tongues
spells.target: One willing creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: The recipient can understand and speak the ordinary languages of creatures addressing it. Its voice remains its own. Reading and writing use languages it already knows.

spells.name: Sending
spells.target: One creature you personally know on the same plane
spells.effect: Send up to twenty-five words through a mental thread. The recipient knows who sent it and may answer with twenty-five words. A creature that chooses silence still receives the message.

spells.name: Telepathic Bond
spells.target: Self and up to five willing creatures within 3 squares
spells.effect: Create a shared mental conversation reaching 1 kilometer. Participants exchange words and simple images by intent while conscious. Each participant may leave the link at any time.

spells.name: Modify Memory
spells.target: One willing creature within 3 squares
spells.duration: 10 minutes of conversation; altered memory lasts until restored
spells.effect: Help the recipient replace or soften one memory covering up to five minutes of a real event. It chooses the replacement account with you. Add 1/2/3 progress toward target 3, with each further conversation attempt taking a Main Action and a new casting. At completion the altered recollection becomes its remembered account. Greater Restoration or a matching consensual working restores the original.

spells.name: Inner Thoughts
spells.target: One creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: Read a thought connected to one question you speak aloud. Learn 1/2/3 relevant images or associations from its present thinking. The recipient knows the question and intrusion; responses remain bounded by its actual knowledge.

spells.name: Mind Scan
spells.target: One willing adjacent creature throughout the ritual
spells.effect: Search one area of its remembered experience together. Add 2/4/6 progress toward a DA-set recollection objective. The subject chooses which memories to explore and can halt the ritual.

spells.name: Mind Probe
spells.target: One creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: Press into a guarded thought. Deal 3/5/7 mental damage and learn one immediate intention the target is considering. For a hero, its player states that intention. The target recognizes your intrusion.

spells.name: Thought Steal
spells.target: One willing adjacent creature
spells.effect: Borrow one ordinary language or one factual recollection the subject agrees to share. You can use it for the duration; the subject retains it. Record the exact knowledge gained. Learned abilities and SP remain with their owner.

spells.name: Vicious Mockery
spells.target: One creature within 6 squares that can hear you
spells.effect: Turn a cutting phrase into a psychic sting. Deal 2/3/5 mental damage.

spells.name: Heroism
spells.target: One willing creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: Bolster its courage. Reduce Frightened by 2 immediately and grant 1 Boon to rolls made while confronting a visible source of fear.

spells.name: Charm Person
spells.target: One creature within 3 squares that can hear and understand you
spells.duration: Until the social exchange ends, up to 10 minutes
spells.effect: Offer an appealing introduction. Add 1/2/3 progress toward an attainable social objective involving a friendly hearing or small favor. During the exchange, the target senses you as approachable. The DA establishes the concession and its boundaries before casting.

spells.name: Calm Emotions
spells.target: Up to three creatures within 6 squares that can hear you
spells.effect: Send a steadying hush through the group. Reduce each target's Frightened by 1/2/3. Willing listeners may also pause an argument long enough for one person to speak.

spells.name: Suggestion
spells.target: One creature within 6 squares that understands your words
spells.duration: One social objective, up to 10 minutes
spells.effect: Frame a specific, feasible course of action that appeals to the target. Add 2/3/4 progress toward the DA's stated persuasion objective. Each further casting needs a new relevant reason or changed circumstance, following social progress rules.

spells.name: Fear
spells.target: Every creature in a 3-square cone that can perceive you
spells.effect: Appear as an overwhelming source of dread. Apply Frightened 1/2/3, with you as its source. Each creature retains control of its movement and decisions.

spells.name: Charm Monster
spells.target: One creature within 6 squares able to understand an offered image or emotion
spells.duration: One social objective, up to 10 minutes
spells.effect: Establish rapport through shared sensations even across a language barrier. Add 2/4/6 progress toward a feasible request stated by the DA. The creature's needs and motives shape what you can ask of it.

spells.name: Confusion
spells.target: Up to three creatures within 6 squares
spells.effect: Scatter attention with conflicting impulses. Apply Dazed 1/1/2. Each affected creature chooses its remaining action categories normally when its turn begins.

spells.name: Mass Suggestion
spells.target: Up to six creatures within 6 squares that understand you and share a motive
spells.duration: One social objective, up to 10 minutes
spells.effect: Propose one common course of action. Add 3/5/7 progress toward a single attainable group objective. The DA sets the concession and boundaries before casting. A later attempt needs a new relevant contribution.

spells.name: Dominate Person
spells.target: One creature within 6 squares that understands you
spells.duration: Until the end of its next turn
spells.effect: State one brief command: move to a named safe place, release a held object, or perform one ordinary interaction. On its turn the target chooses to perform that command using its own actions or suffer Dazed 1/2/3 from resisting the pressure. Once that choice resolves, the command ends.

spells.name: Antipathy/Sympathy
spells.target: One fixed object or 3-square-radius place within reach
spells.effect: Choose a recognizable group and either welcome or dread. When a matching creature first enters, it feels the chosen pull and recognizes it as magic. Welcome supplies 1 Boon to your group's first relevant social contribution there; dread applies Frightened 1/2/3, set by your ritual roll, once per creature. Identify the object or place as the fear source.

spells.name: Minor Illusion
spells.target: One point within 6 squares; a sound or still image fitting one square
spells.effect: Create a simple sound or stationary visual image. An image is insubstantial; a sound can be as loud as ordinary speech. Physical interaction reveals the illusion. You can keep one Minor Illusion at a time.

spells.name: Silent Image
spells.target: An image fitting a 2-by-2-square space within 6 squares
spells.effect: Shape a silent moving image. Each upkeep may move it up to 3 squares and alter its gestures. Physical interaction reveals its insubstantial nature; observers may examine it using the shared illusion procedure.

spells.name: Disguise Self
spells.target: Self
spells.effect: Change your apparent face, clothing and proportions within your existing size. Your voice and tangible shape remain physical. Touch reveals mismatches; close inspection uses the shared illusion procedure.

spells.name: Mirror Image
spells.target: Self
spells.duration: 1 minute or until three attacks resolve against you
spells.effect: Create three shifting doubles. Gain 1 Boon to defenses against attacks that depend on seeing you. After each such attack resolves, one double vanishes. The remaining doubles provide the same single Boon.

spells.name: Invisibility
spells.target: Self or one willing creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: Make the recipient and its carried gear Invisible. Attacking or casting another spell ends this casting's invisibility after that action resolves. Other senses can still locate the recipient.

spells.name: Major Image
spells.target: An image fitting a 3-by-3-square space within 8 squares
spells.effect: Create a moving illusion with sound, scent and harmless temperature. Each upkeep can move it 3 squares and change its performance. Touch reveals its insubstantial nature. It may conceal a real feature visually; physical terrain remains as it was.

spells.name: Greater Invisibility
spells.target: Self or one willing creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: Make the recipient and carried gear Invisible. It may continue attacking and casting while this effect lasts. Attacking still reveals its location and ends Hidden normally.

spells.name: Hallucinatory Terrain
spells.target: A fixed 10-by-10-square outdoor area within 10 squares
spells.effect: Change the area's apparent plants, surfaces and small terrain features. Buildings and creatures retain their appearance. Real footing remains physical; touch or travel through a mismatch reveals it, and observation uses the illusion procedure.

spells.name: Mislead
spells.target: Self and an illusory double within 6 squares
spells.effect: Become Invisible while creating a visible, speaking double of yourself. Each upkeep may move the double 3 squares. You may see and hear from either your own position or the double's, choosing during upkeep. Attacking ends your invisibility after resolution but leaves the double until sustain ends.

spells.name: Seeming
spells.target: Up to six willing creatures within 3 squares
spells.effect: Give each recipient an apparent humanoid disguise using Disguise Self's limits. Design each disguise when casting. Each recipient may dismiss its own disguise with a Maneuver.

spells.name: Programmed Illusion
spells.target: One fixed 3-by-3-square space within reach
spells.effect: Prepare a visual and audible performance lasting up to 1 minute. State a visible or audible trigger within 6 squares when casting. The first matching event plays the recorded illusion once. Physical interaction reveals it; afterward the spell ends.

spells.name: Dreams
spells.target: One willing sleeping creature within 1 square
spells.effect: Share one brief harmless dream image or soothing sensation. The sleeper later remembers it as a dream. Ordinary waking ends the exchange.

spells.name: Sleep
spells.target: One creature within 4 squares
spells.effect: Send drowsiness over the target. Apply Slowed 1/2/3; on Strong also apply Asleep 1. Damage or ordinary waking procedures end Asleep.

spells.name: Dream Message
spells.target: One willing sleeping creature you personally know on the same plane
spells.effect: Appear in a short dream and exchange up to fifty words each. The recipient recognizes you and remembers the conversation on waking. The ritual reaches the subject only while it is asleep.

spells.name: Phantasmal Force
spells.target: One creature within 6 squares
spells.effect: Create a troubling sensory image that only the target perceives. Apply Frightened 1/2/3, naming the image as its source. Each upkeep renews Frightened 1. Physical contact or a completed illusion examination exposes it and ends its fear contribution.

spells.name: Hypnotic Pattern
spells.target: Up to three creatures in a 2-square-radius area within 8 squares that can see the pattern
spells.effect: Weave a mesmerizing display. Apply Dazed 1/1/2 to each chosen target. Sight is required when the spell resolves.

spells.name: Phantasmal Killer
spells.target: One creature within 6 squares
spells.effect: Make a private nightmare seem to strike. Deal 3/5/7 mental damage and apply Frightened 1, with the nightmare as its source until your next turn ends.

spells.name: Dream
spells.target: One willing sleeping creature you personally know on the same plane
spells.effect: Meet in a shared dream with speech and vivid images. Each participant can recall the exchange afterward. The dream ends if either wakes; you can show remembered experiences as you recall them.

spells.name: Sign of Sleep
spells.target: One visible mark on an object within reach
spells.effect: The first creature to read or closely examine the mark receives Slowed 2/3/4 and Asleep 1/1/2, set by your casting roll. Its appearance suggests a magical inscription. Damage or waking ends Asleep normally. The mark triggers once.

spells.name: Lord Dream
spells.target: Self and up to five willing sleepers within 3 squares
spells.effect: Host a shared dream with chosen scenery and conversation. Participants may practice, exchange memories or plan together. Each receives 1 Boon on its first roll directly implementing one agreed plan within 24 hours; record that plan before waking.

spells.name: Weird
spells.target: Up to six creatures within 8 squares
spells.effect: Surround the targets with personalized waking terrors. Roll once; each takes 3/5/7 mental damage and gains Frightened 2, with the visions as source until your next turn ends.

spells.name: Astral Projection
spells.target: Self and up to three willing creatures beside you
spells.effect: Send visible spirit projections into the nearby spirit realm while bodies sleep. Projections travel together up to 1 kilometer from the bodies, speak with spirits and observe corresponding places. They return when the spell ends or a body is disturbed. Projections use observation and speech; physical acts and further casting take place after returning to the bodies.

spells.name: Detect Magic
spells.target: One visible object or creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: Sense whether an active magical effect is present on the target. Learn whether the strongest visible aura is protective, transformative, harmful or informative. Closely concealed sources require examination through stronger pages.

spells.name: Detect Poison and Disease
spells.target: Food, drink or one willing creature within 1 square
spells.effect: Determine whether ordinary poison or disease is present and identify its broad type: ingested, inhaled, contact or bodily infection. The reading helps select suitable treatment.

spells.name: Detect Evil and Good
spells.target: Visible creatures or objects within 6 squares
spells.effect: Perceive the presence of summoned forms, undead and active spirit bindings. Learn which visible targets bear those properties. Their motives are discovered through interaction.

spells.name: Find Traps
spells.target: One visible 3-by-3-square area within 6 squares
spells.effect: Sense intentionally prepared mechanisms or magical triggers that could harm an entrant. Add 1/2/3 progress toward a search objective set by the DA. At completion identify each detected trigger's location and how it is activated; disarming uses its own procedure.

spells.name: See Invisibility
spells.target: Self
spells.effect: See Invisible creatures and objects within 6 squares as translucent outlines. This satisfies visual targeting at that distance; solid cover still blocks sight.

spells.name: Identify
spells.target: One adjacent object examined throughout the ritual
spells.effect: Learn 1/2/3 facts about its active magical properties, chosen from activation, charges or costs, duration, and an explicit drawback. The DA gives accurate facts available from the item's current enchantment.

spells.name: True Seeing
spells.target: Self
spells.effect: Within 6 squares, see Invisible targets and perceive the original outline beneath visual illusions or disguising magic. You recognize illusion as illusion while retaining sight of the underlying scene. Solid barriers retain their normal visibility limits.

spells.name: Analysis
spells.target: One adjacent object, creature or fixed magical effect
spells.effect: Add 2/4/6 progress toward understanding one magical effect, with target 6. Each completed analysis reveals its purpose, remaining duration, SP upkeep and one named remedy or interruption method. Use further castings for further effects.

spells.name: Detect Magic — Scaling Analysis
spells.target: Up to three visible magical sources within 6 squares
spells.effect: Read their relative strength. Learn each source's spell name if known, its SP cost or equivalent strength, and its remaining duration on Standard or Strong; Weak reveals only the strongest source and whether it is sustained. Choose all targets before rolling.

spells.name: Find the Path
spells.target: Self; a known fixed destination within 1 kilometer
spells.effect: Sense the direction of an ordinary traversable route to a location you previously visited. At each junction, learn which way continues along that route. Terrain and locks still require ordinary travel and interaction; if no traversable route exists, the reading identifies the nearest obstruction.

spells.name: Sight True
spells.target: Self
spells.effect: See Invisible targets and recognize visual illusions within 12 squares. Also see the outlines of creatures immediately beyond ordinary cover up to 1 square thick, within 6 squares. Such outlines reveal position; attacks still require a clear path.

spells.name: Nightsight
spells.target: Self
spells.effect: See clearly in dim light within 6 squares. In complete darkness, perceive only shapes already illuminated by a light source.

spells.name: Clairvoyance
spells.target: One visible point within 12 squares
spells.effect: Place an invisible stationary sensor. Choose sight or hearing when casting; spend a Main Action to use that sense from the sensor until your next turn starts. Your own corresponding sense is occupied during that interval.

spells.name: Locate Object
spells.target: One familiar object within 100 squares
spells.effect: Sense its direction while holding an item of the same material. Choose a specific object you have handled or the nearest example of a common kind. Magical concealment expressly blocking divination stops the signal.

spells.name: Locate Creature
spells.target: One creature you personally know within 100 squares
spells.effect: Sense its direction and whether it is moving closer or farther away. You need a personal possession it used within the last month. The reading follows the creature's current body.

spells.name: Arcane Eye
spells.target: One sensor initially within 3 squares; remains within 12 squares
spells.effect: Create a tiny visible glimmering eye. Each upkeep moves it up to 4 squares through open passages. Spend a Main Action to see from it until your next turn begins. The sensor has 1 HP and uses your Agility for player-rolled defenses.

spells.name: Scrying
spells.target: One consenting creature you personally know on the same plane
spells.effect: Receive an image and sound of the space within 3 squares of the subject. Weak gives one brief glimpse, Standard up to thirty seconds, Strong the full minute. The subject senses your presence and may end the connection.

spells.name: Long Ear
spells.target: One point you have visited within 1 kilometer
spells.effect: Place a stationary listening sensor. Spend a Main Action to listen from it until your next turn begins. It hears ordinary sounds within 6 squares of that point, subject to intervening barriers and noise.

spells.name: Watch II
spells.target: Two fixed points within 12 squares
spells.effect: Mark two observation points. While within 12 squares of either, you may spend a Main Action to see and hear from one until your next turn begins. Switching points takes another Main Action. Each viewpoint follows normal line of sight and hearing.

spells.name: Watch True
spells.target: Up to four fixed points you have visited within 1 kilometer
spells.effect: Prepare a network of stationary observation points. A Main Action lets you see and hear from one until your next turn begins. Choose a different point with another Main Action. Magical concealment and ordinary barriers operate at each viewpoint.

spells.name: Long Sense
spells.target: One point you have visited within 10 kilometers
spells.effect: Send sight and hearing to that fixed location. Spend a Main Action each round to observe until your next turn begins. While observing, your own sight and hearing rest at the remote point; touch can still alert you to nearby contact.

spells.name: Long Sense True
spells.target: One willing creature you personally know on the same plane
spells.effect: Establish a remote sensory link. While both consent, use a Main Action to share what it sees and hears until your next turn begins. It continues using its own senses normally and may end the link at any time.

spells.name: Origins
spells.target: One unattended object held in your hands
spells.effect: Sense its principal ordinary material and whether it was grown, shaped, mined or assembled. This gives a useful starting point for further investigation.

spells.name: Past Visions
spells.target: One adjacent fixed place or unattended object
spells.effect: Receive 1/2/3 sensory impressions of its most recent notable event within the past day. The DA presents concrete sights, sounds or touches from that event.

spells.name: Power Lore
spells.target: One adjacent magical object
spells.effect: Learn 1/2/3 historical facts about how its enchantment was made or previously used. Facts concern its actual history, not current activation instructions unless the remembered event demonstrates them.

spells.name: Item Vision
spells.target: One object held throughout the ritual
spells.effect: See a brief scene involving its most recent owner within the last month. Weak reveals the owner's appearance, Standard also the scene's surroundings, and Strong also one spoken exchange of up to twenty words.

spells.name: Vision Guide
spells.target: One adjacent site
spells.effect: Ask how one visible trace came to be here. Add 1/2/3 progress toward a historical inquiry objective, target 3. At completion see the event that left that trace, if it occurred within the last year.

spells.name: Delving
spells.target: One adjacent object or ruin
spells.effect: Add 2/4/6 progress toward uncovering one named part of its history, target 6. At completion learn who made it, its intended purpose, and one subsequent event relevant to your question, reaching back up to a century.

spells.name: Vision Location
spells.target: One object held; its former location within 10 kilometers
spells.effect: See the surroundings where the object spent the longest uninterrupted time during the last month. Learn the direction and approximate distance from your present location if that place lies within range.

spells.name: Past Store
spells.target: One held crystal or polished stone
spells.effect: Store up to one minute of what you personally see and hear during the ritual. A later Main Action holding the stone plays the memory as a small shared image and sound. The stone holds one recording; you may keep three prepared stones.

spells.name: Legend Lore
spells.target: One adjacent historic object or site; 25 coins of incense consumed
spells.effect: Ask one question about an important event in its history. Weak reveals one truthful clue, Standard a brief accurate account, and Strong the account plus a practical lead to evidence or another witness. The DA draws from the object's real past.

spells.name: Past Truth
spells.target: One adjacent site and one specific event within the past year
spells.effect: View up to ten minutes of that event from a fixed point at the site. The vision shows what happened there, including audible speech. Magical concealment that obscured the event remains part of the vision.

spells.name: Vision Behind — Ages
spells.target: One adjacent ancient site; 100 coins of rare incense consumed
spells.effect: Explore one named event up to a thousand years old. Add 3/5/7 progress toward target 7. At completion witness up to one hour from a fixed position and learn one surviving location or object connected to it. Each further attempt requires a new ritual and its costs.

spells.name: True Strike
spells.target: One adjacent creature with a melee weapon, or one visible creature within 8 squares with a ranged weapon
spells.effect: Follow a brief vision of the opening to come. Make one weapon attack using Reason and deal 2/3/5 physical damage. Use the weapon's ordinary hand and ammunition requirements.

spells.name: Guidance
spells.target: One willing creature within 3 squares
spells.duration: Until its next roll or your next turn ends
spells.effect: Offer a useful flash of intuition. Give 1 Boon to the recipient's next non-attack task roll. A creature can hold one Guidance benefit at a time.

spells.name: Augury
spells.target: One course of action you intend to begin within 10 minutes
spells.effect: Ask whether the contemplated course is likely to bring benefit, danger, both or neither during the next hour. The DA answers from current circumstances. New decisions can change the outcome. Ask once per distinct proposed course between overnight rests.

spells.name: Intuitions
spells.actionText: Reaction · before you roll a defense
spells.target: Self
spells.effect: A momentary warning sharpens your response. Gain 1 Boon to that defense.

spells.name: Anticipations I
spells.target: Self
spells.effect: Read the next immediate threat. Once during the duration, gain 2 Boons to one defense you declare before rolling. The spell ends when you use that benefit.

spells.name: Spell Anticipations
spells.actionText: Reaction · when a visible caster begins a spell targeting you
spells.trigger: when a visible caster begins a spell targeting you
spells.target: Self; caster within 8 squares
spells.effect: Recognize its magical approach. Learn the spell's action, damage type or principal condition before choosing any remaining response. Gain 1 Boon to your defense against that spell.

spells.name: Divination
spells.target: One specific undertaking planned for the next day
spells.effect: Seek a warning. Weak reveals one relevant omen, Standard adds a concrete obstacle, and Strong adds a practical way to prepare. The DA describes possibilities based on present circumstances, not a compulsory future.

spells.name: Commune
spells.target: One spiritual patron or source with which you have an established relationship
spells.effect: Ask up to three questions answerable by yes, no or uncertain. Answers reflect that source's knowledge and may be uncertain where events or secrets exceed it. You can seek this communion once between safe overnight rests.

spells.name: Foresight
spells.target: One willing creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: Give the recipient 1 Boon to defenses. Once during the duration, after a defense roll, it may reroll the whole roll and keep either result. Recasting replaces the previous benefit on that creature.

spells.name: Anticipations True
spells.actionText: Reaction · after you roll a defense
spells.target: Self
spells.effect: Follow an alternate future. Reroll the whole defense and keep either result. Use at most one Anticipations True casting on a given defense.

spells.name: Spell Anticipation True
spells.actionText: Reaction · when a visible spell targets you or an ally within 3 squares
spells.trigger: when a visible spell targets you or an ally within 3 squares
spells.target: You and up to two targeted allies within 3 squares
spells.effect: Warn the chosen recipients before their defenses are rolled. Each gains 2 Boons to its defense against that spell. Each creature resolves its own defense normally.

spells.name: Chill Touch
spells.target: One creature within 6 squares
spells.effect: A spectral hand closes around the target. Deal 2/3/5 life damage.

spells.name: Gentle Repose
spells.target: One adjacent corpse
spells.effect: Preserve the body from ordinary decay. Time under Gentle Repose still counts toward any spell's stated resurrection deadline; preservation keeps the remains suitable for examination or rites.

spells.name: Speak with Dead
spells.target: One adjacent corpse with a recognizable head
spells.effect: Call an echo of its remembered experience. Weak permits one question, Standard two, Strong three. The DA answers from what the person knew in life, in brief sensory recollections. A corpse can provide this echo once between safe overnight rests.

spells.name: Spirit Guardians
spells.target: Up to three creatures within 2 squares of you
spells.effect: Spirits wheel around you. When cast, deal 2/3/5 radiant damage to the chosen creatures. On a later turn, spend a Main Action and roll again to strike up to three creatures currently within 2 squares. Upkeep preserves the spirits between those attacks.

spells.name: Lifekeeping
spells.actionText: Reaction · when a visible living creature within 3 squares gains its third failure mark
spells.trigger: when a visible living creature within 3 squares gains its third failure mark
spells.target: That creature
spells.duration: Until the end of your next turn
spells.effect: Hold its departing spirit. The hold delays death until it expires or the creature rolls another Weak on a death roll. Stabilizing it or restoring its HP during the hold saves it. Damage at 0 HP still triggers death rolls. Each creature can benefit once between safe overnight rests.

spells.name: Animate Dead
spells.target: One open square within 3 squares
spells.effect: Shape an Undead energy form rated 1 from Summoned Companions, using nearby bones as a visual focus. It uses its printed profile, immediate Main command, normal commands and six-square tether. Its departure leaves the original bones.

spells.name: Control Undead
spells.target: One independent undead creature within 6 squares
spells.duration: Until the end of its next turn
spells.effect: Press a spirit-binding command to halt, retreat up to its Speed, or release a held object. The creature chooses to obey using its own actions or take 3/5/7 radiant damage and Frightened 1. A player decides that choice for their own creature.

spells.name: Contact Other Plane
spells.target: One known spirit or planar source
spells.effect: Ask one question. Weak brings a truthful but symbolic clue, Standard a direct answer within the source's knowledge, and Strong adds a relevant warning or lead. The DA establishes the source's identity and disposition through the contact.

spells.name: Etherealness
spells.target: Self and carried gear
spells.effect: Step partly into the spirit realm. Move at half Speed through ordinary solid material up to 1 square thick, ending each turn in open space. Observe spirits and physical surroundings as pale outlines. Return with a Maneuver to handle physical objects or cast. Expiry returns you to the nearest open square within 3 squares.

spells.name: Create Undead
spells.target: One open space within 3 squares
spells.effect: Shape one Undead energy form rated 7 or lower from Summoned Companions. Give its immediate Main command and use the printed profile, normal commands and six-square tether.

spells.name: Lifegiving
spells.target: One willing dead person whose intact body is adjacent; death within the past minute
spells.effect: Consume 100 coins of funerary incense and return the person at 1 HP, with both death roll tallies cleared and fatal injuries closed. The spirit chooses whether to return. Retain scars, spent SP and spent Grit. This uses the person's one lifetime return through Lifegiving, Mass Lifegiving or True Resurrection.

spells.name: Familiar
spells.target: One willing ordinary Small animal beside you
spells.effect: Form a companionship bond through food and care. You sense whether the animal is calm, frightened or hurt while within 6 squares. It remains an ordinary independent animal with its own needs. You may keep one Familiar bond; forming another releases the first.

spells.name: Find Familiar
spells.target: One open square within 3 squares
spells.effect: Shape a familiar using the Raven or Cave Bat summoned profile. Apply the normal six-square tether and command rules. Give its immediate Main command when it appears. It returns to energy when its duration ends.

spells.name: Unseen Servant
spells.target: One open square within 3 squares
spells.effect: Call a Clay Helper energy form from Summoned Companions. Its appearance is a faint translucent outline. Use its printed profile, immediate Main command, six-square tether and continuing commands for chores and movement.

spells.name: Summon Animal
spells.target: One open square within 3 squares
spells.effect: Summon one Animal profile rated 1 from Summoned Companions. Give its immediate Main command, then use the normal command, six-square tether and disappearance rules.

spells.name: Phantom Steed
spells.target: One open square within 3 squares
spells.effect: Shape a spectral riding horse using the Warhorse summoned profile. Give its immediate Main command. Continue directing it through the normal command procedure; movement carries its rider using the ordinary mounted movement rules and six-square tether.

spells.name: Conjure Animals
spells.target: One open space within 3 squares
spells.effect: Call one Animal profile rated 3 or lower. It may appear as a small pack moving as one form: use that single profile, footprint and shared HP. Give one immediate Main command and use the normal command and tether rules.

spells.name: Conjure Elemental
spells.target: One open space within 3 squares
spells.effect: Call one Elemental profile rated 3 or lower. Use its printed statistics, immediate Main command, normal command economy and six-square tether.

spells.name: Summon Dragon
spells.target: One open space within 3 squares
spells.effect: Manifest a serpentine storm-dragon using the Storm Column summoned profile. Its shape expresses the spell; use that profile's movement, attacks and defenses. Give one immediate Main command, then normal commands and the six-square tether.

spells.name: Conjure Celestial
spells.target: One open space within 3 squares
spells.effect: Call a radiant champion using the Oath Flame summoned profile. Give its immediate Main command and follow the normal six-square tether and command procedures. Any healing it performs spends your SP as printed.

spells.name: Planar Ally
spells.target: One named otherworldly being with which you have an established relationship
spells.effect: Invite the being to negotiate one specific service. The DA presents its response, terms and requested payment. Agreement establishes when and how it can assist through its actual capabilities. Any creature that arrives is an independent guest, with the agreed role and duration of service.

spells.name: Gate — Calling
spells.target: One named willing being on another plane; arrival within 3 squares of you
spells.effect: Send an invitation naming the destination and purpose. If accepted, open a doorway through which that being and its carried possessions may enter once. The door closes after its arrival or after one minute. The guest acts independently; agree on its service through conversation.

spells.name: Thaumaturgy
spells.target: Self or one unattended feature within 3 squares
spells.effect: Magnify your voice to carry across a hall, make a small flame flicker, or cause one unlocked door to creak. Choose one harmless display when casting.

spells.name: Command
spells.target: One creature within 4 squares that understands you
spells.duration: Until the end of its next turn
spells.effect: Give a one-word request to approach a safe square, halt movement, or drop a held object. The target may comply using its own actions or take Frightened 1/2/3, with you as source, from resisting the pressure. Its player makes this choice for a hero.

spells.name: Hold Person
spells.target: One humanoid creature within 6 squares
spells.effect: Bands of pale light grip its limbs. Apply Slowed 1/2/3; on Strong also apply Paralyzed 1.

spells.name: Magic Circle
spells.target: A marked 2-square-radius circle centered beside you
spells.effect: Choose summoned forms, undead or spirits. Creatures of that kind gain 2 Banes on attacks crossing the circle boundary. A creature may cross the line by spending a Main Action; crossing breaks no physical barrier. The circle remains while its drawn line is intact.

spells.name: Banishment
spells.target: One creature within 6 squares
spells.effect: Deal 3/5/7 radiant damage to a summoned energy form; at 0 HP it disperses. An independent creature instead takes Frightened 1/2/3, with an image of its home as source. On Strong, a willing extraplanar creature may return to its home plane rather than take that fear.

spells.name: Planar Binding
spells.target: One willing extraplanar creature beside you; 50 coins of incense consumed
spells.duration: One agreed service, up to 24 hours
spells.effect: Seal a clearly spoken agreement defining service, payment and release. Both parties hear the terms. Each gains immediate awareness if the other deliberately breaks them; the injured party may then end the binding and any unpaid obligation. The creature retains its own actions and personality.

spells.name: Geas
spells.target: One willing creature beside you
spells.effect: Bind a mutual oath naming one feasible duty and its completion condition. A participant who knowingly abandons its promised duty gains Frightened 1* with the oath as source until it resumes the duty, makes agreed restitution, or receives Remove Curse. Each participant may carry one Geas oath.

spells.name: Hold Monster
spells.target: One creature within 6 squares
spells.effect: Close binding bands around the target. Apply Slowed 2/3/4 and Paralyzed 1/1/2.

spells.name: Dominate Monster
spells.target: One creature within 6 squares that perceives your command
spells.duration: Until the end of its next turn
spells.effect: Command one ordinary movement or interaction within the creature's abilities. It may obey using its own actions or take 4/6/8 mental damage and Dazed 1/1/2. Its player chooses for a hero. The command ends after that choice resolves.

spells.name: Forcecage
spells.target: An unoccupied 2-by-2-square cage boundary within 6 squares
spells.effect: Form a cage around creatures fitting inside its boundary. Your casting roll gives it 10/15/20 HP. When an NPC casts around heroes, each enclosed hero rolls Reason instead. Use the strongest defense to give the shared cage 20/15/10 HP on Weak/Standard/Strong. The bars block bodily passage but allow sight and ranged targeting. The cage has resistance 2 to all damage and takes at least 1 per attack. Teleportation or destroying it permits escape. The caster may end it with a Maneuver.

spells.name: Imprisonment
spells.target: One willing or continuously restrained adjacent creature; a 100-coin crystal consumed
spells.duration: Until released or the crystal is broken
spells.effect: Enclose the creature in a palm-sized crystal where it sleeps and its needs pause. The crystal has 10 HP and physical resistance 1. Breaking it, Remove Curse, or your Main Action holding it releases the creature into the nearest open square with its prior HP and resources. Keep one such prison at a time.

spells.name: Landing
spells.target: Self
spells.effect: Reduce your effective falling distance by 3 squares and land upright if the landing supports you. Resolve any remaining distance normally.

spells.name: Misty Step
spells.target: Self; an unoccupied supported square you can see within 2 squares
spells.effect: Step through a curl of mist to the chosen square with your carried gear. This teleportation traverses the intervening space instantly.

spells.name: Blink
spells.target: Self
spells.effect: After an attack against you resolves, you may spend your Reaction to teleport to an unoccupied supported square within 2 squares that you can see. Each use consumes one of this spell's three blinks.

spells.name: Dimension Door
spells.target: Self and one adjacent willing creature; a visible destination within 8 squares
spells.effect: Step together through a brief doorway. Arrive in unoccupied supported squares beside the destination with carried gear. If the destination lacks room, remain at your origin and receive a clear impression of the obstruction.

spells.name: Long Door
spells.target: Self and up to three adjacent willing creatures; a known destination within 100 squares
spells.effect: Travel to a place you personally visited within the last day. Arrive in open supported squares at that location. If occupied or obstructed, arrive at the nearest safe space within 3 squares; if none exists, the ritual leaves you at your origin.

spells.name: Teleportation Circle
spells.target: Self and up to five willing creatures beside you; a known circle on the same plane
spells.effect: Consume 25 coins of chalk and incense to travel to a permanent circle whose exact inscription you have studied. Its receiving area must have space for the party. A blocked destination leaves you at the casting site and reveals the obstruction's nature.

spells.name: Passwall
spells.target: One adjacent ordinary wall up to 2 squares thick
spells.effect: Open a passage 1 square wide and 2 high through wood, earth or stone. At expiry, creatures inside move to the nearest open end before the material returns. The opening preserves the surrounding structure's ordinary support.

spells.name: Plane Shift
spells.target: Self and up to five willing adjacent creatures; one known planar anchor
spells.effect: Consume 100 coins of tuned incense and travel to an anchor you personally visited or whose attunement you possess. Arrive beside it in safe open space. A sealed or unavailable anchor leaves the party at its origin with an impression of the obstruction.

spells.name: Teleport
spells.target: Self and up to five willing adjacent creatures; a personally visited place within 100 kilometers
spells.effect: Travel with carried gear to the remembered place. Arrive in safe open squares within 3 squares of it. If that space is unavailable, remain at your origin and learn that the destination is obstructed.

spells.name: Gate — Passage
spells.target: One portal within 3 squares linking a known planar anchor
spells.effect: Consume 100 coins of tuned incense to open a two-way doorway 2 squares wide. Any creature that can reach it may cross while open. The far end must be at an anchor you personally visited and currently have permission to open. You can close it with a Maneuver.

spells.name: Etherealness — Company
spells.target: Self and up to three willing creatures within 3 squares
spells.effect: Shift the company into pale spirit forms. Each uses Etherealness's movement and interaction procedure and may return with a Maneuver. Your upkeep sustains all recipients; on expiry each returns to the nearest open square within 3 squares.

spells.name: Arcane Bolt
spells.target: One creature within 8 squares
spells.effect: Strike with a bolt of compressed force. Deal 2/3/5 force damage.

spells.name: Mage Hand
spells.target: One unattended object of Bulk 1 or less within 4 squares
spells.effect: A spectral hand lifts and moves the object up to 2 squares, or opens one unlocked door or container. It handles ordinary items with simple motions. Each new manipulation uses another casting.

spells.name: Magic Missile
spells.target: Up to three creatures within 8 squares
spells.effect: Send luminous darts along clear paths. Roll once for a shared total of 3/5/7 force damage; divide it before resistance, assigning at least 1 to each target. Each target takes one damage event.

spells.name: Staying
spells.target: One creature within 6 squares
spells.effect: Invisible pressure pins the target's movement. Apply Slowed 1/2/3. On Strong, you can also Slide it 1 square to a visible, supported square. Apply Stability to the Slide.

spells.name: Levitate — Objects
spells.target: One unattended object of Bulk 3 or less within 6 squares
spells.effect: Lift it up to 3 squares from its supporting surface. Each upkeep moves it up to 2 squares through open space. Place it gently when the spell ends. It can carry its ordinary contents, but living riders require their own movement or support.

spells.name: Shatter
spells.target: Every creature and unattended fragile object in a 1-square-radius burst within 6 squares
spells.effect: Sound a sharp resonant crack. Deal 3/5/7 force damage. Ordinary unattended glass or brittle pottery in the burst shatters; sturdier structures use their HP or a DA-set demolition objective.

spells.name: Telekinesis
spells.target: One creature or unattended object within 6 squares
spells.effect: Move a creature 1/2/3 squares toward a visible supported destination, applying Stability. Alternatively, automatically move an unattended object of Bulk 6 or less up to 3 squares. The route must be open and wide enough for the target.

spells.name: Resilient Sphere
spells.target: One willing creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: Enclose it in a translucent sphere with 12 HP and resistance 2 to all damage. Attacks from outside strike the sphere; the recipient may roll it 1 square using its movement. Actions affecting the outside require leaving with a Maneuver. Destruction ends the sphere after that damage event.

spells.name: Wall of Force
spells.target: Six connected unoccupied squares within 8 squares
spells.effect: Raise a transparent force wall 2 squares high. It blocks physical passage and attacks across it. All sections share 18 HP and resistance 2 to all damage; attacks always deal at least 1. Destroying the wall opens all its squares.

spells.name: Disintegrate
spells.target: One creature or unattended object within 8 squares
spells.effect: A narrow beam deals 6/9/12 force damage. An unattended nonmagical object of Bulk 3 or less is reduced to dust if this damage destroys it. Living targets follow normal HP and dying rules.

spells.name: Reverse Gravity
spells.target: Every creature in a 2-square-radius area within 8 squares
spells.duration: Until the end of your next turn
spells.effect: Lift each affected creature 1/2/3 squares vertically, stopping at obstacles. It floats at that height until expiry, when it falls normally. A creature holding a fixed support may release it or remain supported. Flying creatures can use their normal movement to leave the area.

spells.name: Mending
spells.target: One unattended mundane item of Bulk 1 or less in your hands
spells.effect: Rejoin a small clean break or tear while holding all its pieces together. Restore ordinary function to that part. Missing components and substantial reconstruction use repair projects.

spells.name: Grease
spells.target: Four connected ground squares within 6 squares
spells.effect: Coat the ground in slippery magical grease. It becomes difficult terrain. A creature entering from outside may move carefully for 2 additional movement, or become Prone after moving into its first greasy square. Choose when entering.

spells.name: Enlarge/Reduce — Objects
spells.target: One unattended nonmagical object of Bulk 2 or less within 3 squares
spells.effect: Double or halve its dimensions and Bulk, rounding Bulk up with a minimum of 1. Its material and function remain ordinary. It returns to original size at expiry; allow enough space for either size when casting.

spells.name: Unlocking Ways
spells.target: One adjacent mundane lock
spells.effect: Guide its mechanism with invisible tools. Add 1/2/3 progress toward the lock's DA-set opening objective. The spell supplies delicate manipulation; an explicit magical seal uses its named remedy.

spells.name: Heat Metal — Forge
spells.target: One unattended metal workpiece of Bulk 3 or less within reach
spells.effect: Heat it evenly to forging temperature or cool it to a safe working temperature. Use suitable tools to shape it with ordinary Craft procedures. The workpiece cools naturally when the duration ends.

spells.name: Stone Shape — Craft
spells.target: One adjacent unattended stone mass up to one square in each dimension
spells.effect: Shape a simple brace, slab, stair or other solid construction component, preserving its volume. Fine mechanisms and final fitting use ordinary tools. Living stone creatures follow creature-targeting spells.

spells.name: Fabricate
spells.target: Prepared ordinary materials and tools beside you
spells.effect: Transform the materials into one mundane item or component of Bulk 6 or less whose construction you understand. Add 3/5/7 progress toward its ordinary crafting objective, using the normal recipe and material quantities. Finish fine details with the required tools.

spells.name: Earthen Transmutations
spells.target: One adjacent unattended square of earth or stone, up to 1 square deep
spells.effect: Turn loose earth into ordinary stone or ordinary stone into compacted earth. Preserve the material's volume. The DA identifies unsupported structures before casting; changing their support uses the normal collapse procedure.

spells.name: Passwall — Workshop
spells.target: One adjacent ordinary wall up to 2 squares thick
spells.effect: Make a work opening 1 square wide and 2 high through stone or earth. At expiry the opening closes; occupants emerge at the nearest end first. Secure ordinary supports before using it in a load-bearing wall.

spells.name: Meld Wall
spells.target: Two adjacent ordinary stone surfaces, each up to 4 squares in area
spells.effect: Join them into one sound wall or floor, or separate them along one clean seam. Supply adequate support and matching stone. The resulting structure has the strength and vulnerabilities of ordinary masonry.

spells.name: True Polymorph — Objects
spells.target: One unattended nonmagical object of Bulk 6 or less; 100 coins of reagents consumed
spells.effect: Reshape it into another mundane object of equal or smaller Bulk using stone, wood, glass or common iron. Specify its ordinary function and include all necessary parts. At expiry it returns to its original form. It provides ordinary material qualities rather than learned abilities or precious commodities.

spells.name: Prestidigitation
spells.target: One unattended object or 1-square space within 3 squares
spells.effect: Clean or soil a hand-sized surface, change a small object's harmless scent or color, or create a tiny visual spark. Choose one effect when casting; its physical scale remains hand-sized.

spells.name: Unseen Servant — Workshop
spells.target: One open square within 3 squares
spells.effect: Create a Clay Helper energy form from Summoned Companions. Give its immediate Main command. Use its printed abilities, normal commands and six-square tether for workshop chores; provide real tools and materials.

spells.name: Enchanted Rope — Rigging
spells.target: One unattended rope up to 12 squares long within 3 squares
spells.effect: Teach the rope a sequence of up to three knots or anchors in reachable open space. Spend a Maneuver to advance one step. It supports ordinary rope loads after securing itself and retains its normal strength.

spells.name: Dancing Weapon
spells.target: One unattended melee weapon within 3 squares; attack within 6 squares
spells.effect: Set the weapon dancing as a single summoned form with 6 HP, Speed 4 and your attributes for defenses. Give one immediate Main command to attack for 2/4/6 physical damage or perform an ordinary manipulation. Further activity uses normal commands and the six-square tether; it has no independent Reaction.

spells.name: Animate Objects
spells.target: Up to three unattended objects, combined Bulk at most 3, within 3 squares
spells.effect: Animate them as one group with shared 10 HP, Speed 4, and your attributes for defenses. They occupy one square together. Give one immediate Main command to attack one adjacent target for 3/5/7 physical damage or perform a simple task. Use normal commands and the six-square tether thereafter.

spells.name: Low Intelligence
spells.target: One prepared object beside you; 50 coins of reagents consumed
spells.effect: Give it the ability to recognize its name, one voice and three spoken commands. It answers yes or no by a tiny movement or sound and remembers one short instruction. Movement or work uses a separate animation spell and its commands. You may keep one intelligent item of any degree at a time.

spells.name: Medium Intelligence
spells.target: One prepared object beside you; 100 coins of reagents consumed
spells.effect: Give it one spoken language and memory of up to ten short instructions or messages. It can converse in simple sentences and report what was said within 1 square. Movement and work use a separate animation spell's commands. This replaces your prior intelligent item.

spells.name: High Intelligence
spells.target: One prepared object beside you; 150 coins of reagents consumed
spells.effect: Give it one language, a chosen conversational personality and memory of its week's experiences. It hears within 3 squares and can explain recorded instructions. It acts through speech; movement and work require separate animation and commands. This replaces your prior intelligent item.

spells.name: Very High Intelligence
spells.target: One prepared object beside you; 250 coins of reagents consumed
spells.effect: Give it two languages you know, a personality and clear memory of its experiences. It sees and hears within 3 squares and can discuss one field of ordinary knowledge you teach during the ritual. Its physical actions use separate animation and commands. This replaces your prior intelligent item.

spells.name: Simulacrum
spells.target: A willing adjacent living model and 150 coins of shaping materials consumed
spells.effect: Make a likeness with 6 HP, Speed 4, your defense attributes, and the model's appearance and voice. It uses your commands and a six-square tether. A Main command permits one ordinary task or Basic Melee attack for 2/3/5 physical damage using your Knowledge. It has 0 SP and 0 Grit; the form disappears at 0 HP. You may keep one such likeness.

spells.name: Animate Objects — Greater
spells.target: Up to six unattended objects, combined Bulk at most 6, within 3 squares
spells.effect: Animate one group occupying a 2-by-2-square space, with shared 18 HP, Speed 4 and your attributes for defenses. Give one immediate Main command. A Main command can attack up to two adjacent targets for 3/5/7 physical damage each, rolling once, or perform one larger ordinary task. Normal commands and six-square tether apply.

spells.name: Light
spells.target: One willing held or unattended object within 3 squares
spells.effect: Make it shed bright light to 6 squares and dim light for another 3. Choose the color. You may keep one Light casting at a time and end it with a Maneuver.

spells.name: Magic Weapon
spells.target: One held weapon belonging to a willing creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: Give the weapon's damaging attacks +1 physical damage before resistance. Apply this once per target per attack. Use the highest magical weapon damage increase.

spells.name: Elemental Weapon
spells.target: One held weapon belonging to a willing creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: Choose fire, cold or lightning. Its attacks deal that type in place of their normal damage type and add 1 damage before resistance. Use the highest magical weapon damage increase; each attack remains one damage event per target.

spells.name: Rune Mastery
spells.target: One held rune-stone and one known Main Action spell costing at most 2 SP
spells.effect: Pay the stored spell's SP in addition to this ritual. Inscribe its power into the stone. A bearer uses a Main Action to release it, choosing legal targets from their position and using your casting attribute. The stone holds one use; you may keep one prepared Rune Mastery stone at a time.

spells.name: Magic Mouth
spells.target: One adjacent unattended object
spells.effect: Record up to twenty-five spoken words and one visible or audible trigger within 3 squares of the object. The first matching event makes the object speak the message once, then ends the spell.

spells.name: Continual Flame
spells.target: One unattended object held throughout the ritual; 10 coins of luminous oil consumed
spells.effect: Kindle a cool magical flame that sheds bright light to 6 squares. It illuminates without consuming fuel. You may keep up to three such flames; creating a fourth ends the oldest.

spells.name: Holy Symbol
spells.target: One held holy symbol
spells.effect: Consecrate it to your chosen spiritual tradition. A bearer holding it gains 1 Boon to its first healing roll or defense against an undead creature, then the blessing ends. You may keep one consecrated symbol at a time.

spells.name: Weapon I
spells.target: One weapon beside you; 25 coins of enchanting oil consumed
spells.effect: The weapon's damaging attacks gain +1 damage of their normal type before resistance, once per target per attack. Use the highest magical weapon increase. You may keep one Weapon I enchantment at a time.

spells.name: Contingency
spells.target: Self and one known Main Action spell costing at most 2 SP
spells.effect: Pay the chosen spell's SP in addition to this ritual. Name a visible or bodily trigger and legal self-directed effect. When triggered while conscious, spend your Reaction to release that spell on yourself. You may keep one Contingency; casting another replaces the earlier preparation.

spells.name: Armor IV
spells.target: One suit of armor beside you; 100 coins of enchanting oil consumed
spells.effect: Choose fire, cold, lightning, poison, life, radiant, mental or force. While worn with its normal training, the suit grants resistance 2 to that damage type. Use the highest matching resistance. You may keep one Armor IV enchantment at a time.

spells.name: General IV
spells.target: One held mundane item; 100 coins of reagents consumed
spells.effect: Bind one known automatic, non-attack Maneuver spell costing 0 SP to the item. A bearer can use a Maneuver to produce that spell's printed effect from their own position. Only one instance from the item can persist at a time. You may keep one General IV item at a time.

spells.name: Sacred Flame
spells.target: One creature within 8 squares
spells.effect: Call a descending spark of sacred light. Deal 2/3/5 radiant damage.

spells.name: Shield
spells.actionText: Reaction · before you roll a defense against a visible attack
spells.trigger: before you roll a defense against a visible attack
spells.target: Self
spells.effect: Raise a translucent shield. Gain 1 Boon to the defense, then reduce the attack's damage by 1 after resistance, minimum 1.

spells.name: Mage Armor
spells.target: One willing creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: Clothe the recipient in a protective magical outline. Grant physical resistance 1, using the highest matching resistance.

spells.name: Bladeturn
spells.actionText: Reaction · after your defense against an adjacent melee attack
spells.trigger: after your defense against an adjacent melee attack
spells.target: Self
spells.effect: Turn the edge aside. Reduce its physical damage by 2 after resistance, keeping the attack's minimum 1 damage.

spells.name: Protection from Evil and Good
spells.target: One willing creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: Ward the recipient against summoned forms, undead and spirits. It gains 1 Boon to defenses against attacks and hostile spells from those creatures.

spells.name: Protection from Energy
spells.target: One willing creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: Choose fire, cold, lightning or poison. Grant resistance 2 to that type for the duration, using the highest matching resistance.

spells.name: Death Ward
spells.target: One willing creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: The first time damage would reduce the recipient from positive HP to 0, leave it at 1 HP and end the ward. A creature can benefit from Death Ward once between safe overnight rests. Record that use when it triggers.

spells.name: Warding Bond
spells.target: One willing creature within 3 squares; remain within 6 squares
spells.effect: Bind your protection to the recipient. When an attack would damage it, you may spend your Reaction after its resistance and other reductions, before it loses HP. Transfer up to 3 of that damage to yourself, leaving at least 1 on it. The transferred damage bypasses your resistance. The bond ends if either participant becomes unconscious or moves beyond 6 squares.

spells.name: Globe of Invulnerability
spells.target: Self and willing creatures within 2 squares of you
spells.effect: Raise a shimmering globe centered on you. Protected creatures gain 1 Boon to defenses against spells and resistance 2 to spell damage. Apply the highest matching resistance. The protection moves with you.

spells.name: Mind Blank
spells.target: One willing adjacent creature
spells.effect: Veil its thoughts. Grant mental resistance 3 and 2 Boons to defenses against mental spells. Reading its memories or locating it through divination requires its consent while the veil lasts. Ordinary observation and conversation remain available.

spells.name: Prismatic Wall
spells.target: Six connected unoccupied squares within 8 squares
spells.effect: Raise a luminous wall 2 squares high that blocks sight. Roll on casting to set radiant damage at 4/6/8. A creature crossing it takes that damage and Slowed 2, once per creature each round. The caster can end the wall with a Maneuver.

spells.name: Detect Magic — Threads
spells.target: One visible magical effect within 3 squares
spells.effect: See its magical threads. Learn whether it is sustained, fixed-duration or permanent, and which creature is presently sustaining it if that creature is visible.

spells.name: Counterspell
spells.actionText: Reaction · when a visible caster finishes a spell
spells.trigger: when a visible caster finishes a spell
spells.target: The spell; caster within 6 squares
spells.effect: Add 1/2/3 cancellation progress against the triggering spell. Its target is 2 plus its printed SP cost. At completion it ends before resolving. Otherwise its caster receives 1 Bane on any roll made to resolve it; the incomplete cancellation progress then expires.

spells.name: Remove Curse
spells.target: One adjacent cursed creature or object
spells.effect: Add 2/3/4 cancellation progress toward one curse's target, normally 2 plus the source spell's SP cost. Accumulate progress across attempts against that same curse. A source that explicitly names Remove Curse as an immediate remedy ends automatically instead.

spells.name: Dispel Magic
spells.target: One visible ongoing spell within 6 squares
spells.effect: Add 2/3/4 cancellation progress against the chosen effect, target 2 plus its printed SP cost. At completion, end that effect. Partial progress remains while that casting lasts.

spells.name: Cancel Essence
spells.target: One ongoing Elements or Force spell within 6 squares
spells.effect: Read and pull apart its elemental structure. Add 3/4/5 cancellation progress toward target 2 plus the spell's printed SP cost. Completing the objective ends that casting.

spells.name: Cancel Mentalism
spells.target: One ongoing Mentalism or Divination spell within 6 squares
spells.effect: Quiet its mental pattern. Add 3/4/5 cancellation progress toward target 2 plus the spell's printed SP cost. Completing the objective ends that casting.

spells.name: Cancel Channeling
spells.target: One ongoing Life, Invocation, Wards or Spellcraft spell within 6 squares
spells.effect: Sever its channel of power. Add 3/4/5 cancellation progress toward target 2 plus its printed SP cost. Completing the objective ends that casting. Independent creatures contacted by magic retain their own existence.

spells.name: Dispel True
spells.target: Up to three visible ongoing spells within 6 squares
spells.effect: Choose one shared cancellation total of 4/6/8 progress and divide it among the effects, assigning at least 1 to each. Each target is 2 plus that spell's printed SP cost. End each effect whose objective is completed.

spells.name: Antimagic Field
spells.target: A 1-square-radius area centered on you
spells.effect: Create a quiet zone where magical effects, including your own, are suspended except for this field and its upkeep. Casting and magical targeting operate outside the zone; ongoing durations continue to pass inside it. Effects resume after leaving if their durations remain. Mundane equipment and ordinary actions work normally.

spells.name: Cancel True
spells.actionText: Reaction · when a visible caster finishes a spell
spells.trigger: when a visible caster finishes a spell
spells.target: The spell; caster within 8 squares
spells.effect: Add 3/5/7 cancellation progress toward target 2 plus its printed SP cost. At completion it ends before resolving. Otherwise its caster receives 2 Banes on any resolution roll, and incomplete cancellation progress expires.

spells.name: Unessence
spells.target: One adjacent permanent enchantment; 100 coins of cleansing reagents consumed
spells.effect: Add 3/5/7 progress toward target 12 for an ordinary permanent enchantment, or a target specified by the item's own removal rules. At completion remove one identified magical property while preserving the physical item. Each attempt consumes its materials; exceptional artifacts use their printed remedies.

spells.name: Resistance
spells.target: One willing creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: Choose fire, cold, lightning or poison. Grant resistance 1 to that type, using the highest matching resistance.

spells.name: Sanctuary
spells.target: One willing creature within 3 squares
spells.effect: Give the recipient 1 Boon to defenses while it attends to healing, movement or other peaceful actions. Its first attack or harmful spell ends the ward after that action resolves.

spells.name: Quiet Ways
spells.target: Self and up to three willing creatures within 3 squares
spells.effect: Soften footfalls and rustling gear. Recipients gain 1 Boon to sneaking that depends on quiet movement. Speech and deliberate noise remain audible.

spells.name: Tiny Hut
spells.target: A fixed 2-square-radius dome on clear ground beside you
spells.effect: Create a weatherproof shelter for six Medium creatures and their ordinary gear. It has an openable entrance and translucent walls. Ordinary rain, snow and wind stay outside; occupants can leave and return. The shelter provides cover but no resistance to attacks. Choose a safe site for overnight recovery.

spells.name: Private Sanctum
spells.target: One fixed room up to 6 by 6 squares beside you
spells.effect: Seal ordinary sound inside the room and make its windows opaque from outside. Remote magical sensors report only a blank space unless their caster completes a cancellation objective against this working. Doors remain usable by ordinary means.

spells.name: Hallow
spells.target: A fixed 4-square-radius site beside you; 50 coins of incense consumed
spells.effect: Consecrate the site. Willing occupants gain 1 Boon to defenses against undead and spirits while inside. Ordinary remains there resist decay for the duration. Choose the site's visible symbol when casting.

spells.name: Guards and Wards
spells.target: A building of up to six connected rooms beside you
spells.effect: Ward the rooms with soft warning bells. Name up to six guests. When another creature opens an exterior door or window, you hear its location while within 100 squares. It receives Slowed 1 on first entry, once per creature. Doors remain physically operable and warnings persist even after that slowing ends.

spells.name: Antilife Shell
spells.target: A 1-square-radius ring centered on you
spells.effect: A barrier of repelling force surrounds you. A living creature crossing its boundary spends 2 extra movement and becomes Slowed 1, once per round. The ring moves with you; moving it over a creature applies the same effect rather than pushing it automatically.

spells.name: Forbiddance
spells.target: A fixed 6-by-6-square site beside you; 100 coins of incense consumed
spells.effect: Seal the site against teleportation and planar passage. A travel spell entering or leaving arrives at the nearest safe boundary square instead. Ordinary movement remains available. A successful cancellation objective ends the seal.

spells.name: Magnificent Mansion
spells.target: One doorway on an adjacent solid surface
spells.effect: Open a comfortable refuge with six furnished rooms, clean water and bedding for twelve. The entrance remains fixed and visible; you may open or close it with a Maneuver while beside it. At expiry occupants and their possessions emerge into safe space beside the original entrance. Furnishings remain part of the refuge. Food is brought by the guests.

spells.name: Prismatic Wall — Sanctum
spells.target: A fixed ring of up to twelve connected unoccupied squares beside you
spells.effect: Create a luminous boundary 2 squares high and name up to six guests. Others crossing take 3/5/7 radiant damage, set by your ritual roll, and Frightened 1 with the boundary as source, once per creature per round. Named guests cross freely. The ring blocks sight through its colors.

spells.name: Mage Seal
spells.target: One closed unattended container within 1 square
spells.effect: Place a visible personal mark across its opening. Opening the container visibly breaks the mark. You recognize your own seal and whether it was broken when you next inspect it.

spells.name: Alarm
spells.target: One doorway or 2-square-radius area beside you
spells.effect: Name up to six guests. When another creature crosses the boundary, a chime sounds within 6 squares or you receive a mental warning while within 100 squares; choose when casting. The first warning ends the spell.

spells.name: Arcane Lock
spells.target: One adjacent closed door or container
spells.effect: Add magical fastening. An ordinary opening objective increases by 3 progress. Name up to six creatures who may operate it normally. Knock ends the magical fastening automatically. Completing a cancellation objective also ends it. Physical locks remain in place.

spells.name: Knock
