spells.target: One lock or fastening within 3 squares
spells.effect: A sharp knock carries 12 squares. Choose one fastening. Against Arcane Lock, end its magical fastening automatically and leave any physical lock in place. Against an ordinary fastening, roll to add 2/3/4 progress toward opening it.

spells.name: Magic Mouth — Warning
spells.target: One fixed object within reach
spells.effect: Record a warning of up to twenty-five words and a visible or audible trigger within 6 squares. The first matching event speaks the warning loudly enough to hear within 12 squares, then ends the spell.

spells.name: Glyph of Warding
spells.target: One fixed surface within reach; burst within 1 square of it
spells.effect: Inscribe a visible glyph and define a creature crossing or touching its surface as the trigger. On the first trigger, every creature in the burst takes 3/5/7 force damage, set by your ritual roll. The glyph triggers once. Moving its surface more than 1 square ends it safely.

spells.name: Rune Mastery — Seal
spells.target: One fixed seal and one known Main Action spell costing at most 2 SP
spells.effect: Pay the stored spell's SP in addition to the ritual. Choose its targets relative to the seal and a visible or audible trigger within 3 squares. At the first trigger, release it using your attribute and legal targets, then end the seal. Keep one such prepared seal at a time.

spells.name: Secret Chest
spells.target: One adjacent chest holding up to 12 Bulk; 25 coins of incense consumed
spells.effect: Hide the chest and its contents in a private folded space. While beside its original location, use a Main Action to return it there. At expiry it returns automatically to the nearest open space. Living creatures remain outside; keep one Secret Chest at a time.

spells.name: Symbol
spells.target: One fixed visible inscription; targets within 2 squares
spells.effect: Choose a visible trigger and either dread or bewilderment. On its first occurrence, up to three creatures you specify by position gain Frightened 2/3/4 or Dazed 1/1/2, set by your ritual roll. Dread names the inscription as source. The inscription then fades.

spells.name: Sequester
spells.target: One willing creature or unattended object beside you; 100 coins of incense consumed
spells.effect: Place it in a concealed, motionless magical sleep or stasis. It becomes Invisible and its bodily needs pause. Touching it with the token you designate, Remove Curse, or expiry awakens and reveals it. Record its HP and SP on entry; those values return unchanged.

spells.name: Imprisonment — Seal
spells.target: One willing or continuously restrained adjacent creature; a 100-coin crystal consumed
spells.duration: Until released or its seal breaks
spells.effect: Bind the creature sleeping inside a fixed warded chamber of at least one square. Its needs pause. Mark the chamber's door with a visible seal: breaking the door, Remove Curse, or your Main Action at the seal releases the prisoner at its previous HP and SP. Keep one such prison at a time.

spells.name: Power Shock
spells.target: One creature within 6 squares
spells.effect: Strike with a pulse of raw magical pressure. Deal 2/3/5 force damage. This attack changes HP through damage; SP transfer uses the later pages of this book.

spells.name: Give Power
spells.target: One adjacent willing creature with its own SP reserve
spells.effect: After paying this spell's 1 SP cost, transfer up to 3 of your remaining SP to the recipient. Choose the amount up to its missing SP. Subtract every point received from your reserve.

spells.name: Draw Power
spells.target: One adjacent willing creature with its own SP reserve
spells.effect: After paying this spell's 1 SP cost, receive up to 3 SP from the donor, limited by its current reserve and your missing SP. The donor chooses the amount and loses exactly what you receive.

spells.name: Siphon Power
spells.target: One creature within 3 squares with its own SP reserve
spells.effect: Transfer 1/2/3 of the target's current SP into your reserve, limited by its available SP and your missing SP after paying the casting cost. Every point received leaves the target's reserve. An empty reserve transfers 0.

spells.name: Distant Channel
spells.target: One willing creature within 8 squares with its own SP reserve
spells.effect: Give or receive up to 5 existing SP after paying this spell's casting cost. Both parties agree on the direction and amount. Respect the donor's remaining reserve and the recipient's missing SP.

spells.name: Channel Spell
spells.target: One willing ally within 6 squares; targets measured from that ally
spells.effect: Choose one known Main Action spell from outside the Channeling book costing at most 3 SP. Pay its normal cost plus this spell's 3 SP. The ally spends its Reaction immediately to release it from its position, choosing legal targets; you make any casting roll with the spell's attribute. Resolve it once. You remain responsible for any sustain and duration.

spells.name: Directed Siphon
spells.target: One donor and one different recipient within 6 squares, each with its own SP reserve
spells.effect: Transfer 2/3/5 SP from the donor to the recipient. Willing participants may accept the full Strong amount automatically; if either is unwilling, roll once using the least favorable applicable modifiers. Limit transfer to the donor's current SP and recipient's missing SP. Pay the casting cost from your own reserve first.

spells.name: Greater Channel
spells.target: Two different creatures within 6 squares with their own SP reserves
spells.effect: Choose a donor and recipient. Transfer up to 8 existing SP with both parties' consent. If either is unwilling, transfer 3/5/7 instead. Roll once using the least favorable applicable modifiers. Apply the donor's available and recipient's missing SP limits after paying your own casting cost.

spells.name: Lord Channels
spells.target: Self and up to three willing donors within 3 squares
spells.effect: Choose one known Main Action spell from outside the Channeling book costing at most 6 SP. Pay this spell's 5 SP yourself. Each donor spends its Reaction and contributes an agreed amount toward the chosen spell's cost; you pay the remainder. Cast it once with its normal attribute and targets. Contributions pay the spell directly, and you sustain any continuing effect.

spells.name: Rechanneling
spells.actionText: Reaction · when a visible spell transfers SP between creatures
spells.trigger: when a visible spell transfers SP between creatures
spells.target: The transfer and a replacement recipient within 6 squares
spells.effect: Add 3/5/7 cancellation progress against the transfer, target 2 plus its casting SP cost. At completion, redirect its stated transferred amount to the replacement recipient, limited by the original donor's available SP and the new recipient's missing SP. Otherwise the original transfer resolves. Pay your own casting cost separately.

spells.name: Power Bridge
spells.target: Two different creatures within 6 squares with their own SP reserves
spells.effect: Choose a donor and recipient. On casting, and on each later upkeep, transfer up to 6 existing SP if both consent, or roll for 2/4/6 if either is unwilling. Use the donor's current reserve and recipient's missing SP as limits. The bridge ends if either moves beyond 6 squares of you. Your casting and upkeep costs remain separate.

# Arcanist

*You study the impossible until your hands can give it a shape the world must briefly accept.*

## Rules

**Agreed:** minimum 0 in Agility, Knowledge; HP contribution +1 at level 1 and per level thereafter. No multiclassing.

**Starting SP contribution:** +3 maximum SP once, at level 1.

**Starting disciplines:** choose two distinct disciplines from Elements, Force, Invocation, Scholarship, Spellcraft.

**Learning costs:** Discipline access costs 1 DP for every class. Learned steps cost 1/2/2/3 DP; the last requires level 3. Combined abilities require level 7 and cost 3/4/5 DP for two/three/four disciplines.

Choose one class-exclusive signature at levels 1, 3 and 7. Each milestone grants one signature; additional signatures are not purchased separately. No discipline requirements.

## Level 1 choices

- [Bent Trajectory](../cards/signature-arcanist-bent-trajectory.md)
- [Deliberate Spark](../cards/signature-arcanist-deliberate-spark.md)
- [Study the Pattern](../cards/signature-arcanist-study-the-pattern.md)

- [Arcane Deflection](../cards/signature-arcanist-arcane-deflection.md)

## Level 7 choices

- [Choose the Edge](../cards/signature-arcanist-choose-the-edge.md)
- [Open the Circle](../cards/signature-arcanist-open-the-circle.md)

## Signature identity in play

The revised options aim for these moments, with a deliberate advantage over shared
cards of their tier. Each is an independent choice, not a progression chain.

- **Level 1:** Bend a spell’s origin, push creatures with a corner spark, or read ongoing magic.

- **Level 7:** Wear a magical aegis, cast a spell twice, or ward a circle.

classes.name: Warden
classes.referenceMarkdown:
# Warden

*You read the broken fern, the distant cry and the turn of a fleeing creature. When the road ends, your companions look to you.*

## Rules

**Agreed concept:** wilderness guide, tracker and hunter. Nature magic and animal companions are optional shared purchases, not required class features.

**Class foundations:** minimum 0 in Fortitude and Knowledge; HP contribution +2 at level 1 and per level thereafter. No multiclassing.

**Starting SP contribution:** +3 maximum SP once, at level 1.

**Starting disciplines:** choose two distinct disciplines from Wilderness, Marksmanship, Arms, Athletics.

**Learning costs:** Discipline access costs 1 DP for every class. Learned steps cost 1/2/2/3 DP; the last requires level 3. Combined abilities require level 7 and cost 3/4/5 DP for two/three/four disciplines.

Choose one class-exclusive signature at levels 1, 3 and 7. Each milestone grants one signature; additional signatures are not purchased separately. Requirements are class and minimum level only; no discipline or earlier signature is required.

## Level 1 choices

- [Steady Aim](../cards/signature-warden-keep-the-quarry-close.md)
- [Beast Speech](../cards/signature-warden-read-the-passing.md)
- [Twin Strike](../cards/signature-warden-follow-my-footsteps.md)

## Level 3 choices

- [Volley](../cards/signature-warden-stay-on-the-scent.md)
- [Entangling Growth](../cards/signature-warden-through-bramble-and-stone.md)
- [The Green Spear](../cards/signature-warden-a-watchful-rest.md)

## Level 7 choices

- [Mark the Quarry](../cards/signature-warden-turn-the-hunt.md)
- [Call the Wild](../cards/signature-warden-bring-them-through.md)
- [Death from the Blind Spot](../cards/signature-warden-know-what-you-hunt.md)

## The character at the table

A marksman owns the range, a wildcaller owns the land, and a stalker owns the
distance between the two. All three remain available at each milestone; there are
no locked subclasses.

Fortitude and Knowledge express endurance and understanding. Agility remains
valuable to an archer and a dual-wielder, but the class does not demand one weapon
or one attack attribute. +4 HP places its contribution beside Blade and Leader,
below Protector and Unbalanced.


**Starting coin contribution:** +2 coins. See [starting coins](../starting-coins.md).

**Duration:** Until the start of your next turn.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

signatures.name: Create a Window
signatures.target: One willing ally on their turn, before they take any action; choose two visible, unoccupied squares within 6 squares of you.
signatures.duration: Until the end of the ally’s turn.
signatures.limits: Once per round; uses your Reaction.
signatures.effect:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One willing ally on their turn, before they take any action; choose two visible, unoccupied squares within 6 squares of you.

The two squares become connected windows until the end of the ally’s turn. The ally can use the windows once at any point during their turn, either to move through one and out the other, spending 1 square of movement, or to make one attack through one window, measuring range and cover from the other. The ally must be able to see the window they use. The windows vanish at the end of the ally’s turn. This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks.

**Duration:** Until the end of the ally’s turn.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

signatures.name: Out of Body
signatures.target: Self.
signatures.duration: Until the end of your turn.
signatures.effect:
**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self.

Your body falls prone and cannot act, move or take Reactions. It has 3 defense Banes. Your spirit appears in your square or an adjacent free square.

The spirit has Speed 5, can speak, can pass through nonmagical solid objects and creatures, and is immune to mundane attacks. It cannot attack, cast spells, use equipment or physically interact with objects. Its movement does not provoke opportunity attacks. Magical attacks can target it; resolve them against your normal defenses, and damage to the spirit is damage to your body. If your body drops to 0 HP, the projection ends.

At the end of your turn, choose one:

- **Snap Back:** Your spirit returns to your body.
- **Manifest:** Your body appears in the spirit’s square or the nearest free square that is not separated from your body by a solid barrier, prone. The projection ends.

If no legal Manifest square exists, you can only Snap Back.

**Duration:** Until the end of your turn.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

flavor: Leave your prone body and move as a spirit that can pass through nonmagical objects and creatures. End the projection by returning to your body or bringing it to a legal square near your spirit.

signatures.target: One ally within 5 squares that would die from its third failure mark.
signatures.duration: Until the beginning of the ally’s next turn.
signatures.limits: Once per day per character; uses your Reaction.
signatures.effect:
**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One ally within 5 squares that would die from its third failure mark.

The ally does not die yet. It remains at 0 HP with three failure marks until the beginning of its next turn and makes no further death rolls during the delay. If it is stabilized or healed above 0 before then, it survives. At the beginning of its next turn, if it still has three failure marks, it dies unless it spends Grit immediately.

**Duration:** Until the beginning of the ally’s next turn.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

signatures.name: In the Gap
signatures.target: A frontage of three squares: your square and the squares immediately to your left and right.
signatures.duration: Until the start of your next turn.
signatures.effect:
**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** A frontage of three squares: your square and the squares immediately to your left and right.

Until the start of your next turn, enemies cannot move past that frontage while you are standing and conscious. Your square is already blocked by your body; this extends the block to the squares on either side. Enemies can still attack you, shove you, or attack allies with ranged attacks. If you move, fall, or are moved away, the effect ends.

**Duration:** Until the start of your next turn.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

The line does not block movement.

**Duration:** Until the start of your next turn.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** Brawn for the granted attack

basicActions.name: Command a Summon
basicActions.target: One of your summons within 6 squares of you.
basicActions.duration: Granted actions are used immediately during your turn; none are saved for later turns.
basicActions.limits: Pay each command’s action cost; at most one command per summon per controller turn, including its immediate summoning command.
basicActions.effect:
**Action:** Main Action or Maneuver · **Attribute:** None — no roll

**Target / range / shape:** One of your summons within 6 squares of you.

Spend Main Action to grant it Main Action plus Maneuver, or spend Maneuver to grant it Maneuver plus movement. Resolve its activity during your turn. Normal downward conversions apply; a Main command can convert the granted Maneuver to movement before an attack.

One command per summon on your turn. You may command two different summons using your Main Action and Maneuver. A new summon receives the summoning card’s immediate free Main command, which counts as its command that turn.

At the end of your turn, each of your summons that received no command that turn disappears. A command gives the summon activity for this turn. Existing conditions, durations and passive defenses continue to apply. See the [summoning rules](../rules/summoning.md) for the tether and command limits.

Name the desired task; the chosen bestiary summon profile determines whether it can perform it and the action/roll required. A command grants neither extra capabilities nor automatic success. See the [command examples and bestiary requirements](../rules/summoning.md).

# Command a Summon

*Direct one of your summons to act within its six-square tether.*

## Rules

**Action:** Main Action or Maneuver · **Attribute:** None — no roll

**Target / range / shape:** One of your summons within 6 squares of you.

Spend Main Action to grant it Main Action plus Maneuver, or spend Maneuver to grant it Maneuver plus movement. Resolve its activity during your turn. Normal downward conversions apply; a Main command can convert the granted Maneuver to movement before an attack.

One command per summon on your turn. You may command two different summons using your Main Action and Maneuver. A new summon receives the summoning card’s immediate free Main command, which counts as its command that turn.

At the end of your turn, each of your summons that received no command that turn disappears. A command gives the summon activity for this turn. Existing conditions, durations and passive defenses continue to apply. See the [summoning rules](../rules/summoning.md) for the tether and command limits.

Name the desired task; the chosen bestiary summon profile determines whether it can perform it and the action/roll required. A command grants neither extra capabilities nor automatic success. See the [command examples and bestiary requirements](../rules/summoning.md).

**Duration:** Granted actions are used immediately during your turn; none are saved for later turns.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

---

**Tier / minimum level:** Universal · **DP:** Not purchased · **Requirements to learn:** None

**Type:** Universal

**Limits:** Pay each command’s action cost; at most one command per summon per controller turn, including its immediate summoning command.
